blob: mesoscopic numerical simulation during selective laser melting of maraging steel 摘要： 激光选区熔化(selective laser melting, slm)成形过程涉及多种发生于介观尺度下的物理现象,采用试验方法难以揭示物理现象复杂的形成规律。以 18ni-300 马氏体时效钢为 slm 成形材料,采用离散元法与有限体积法建立了 slm 成形介观尺度热流耦合数值模型,并结合熔道成形试验验证模型的正确性。结合数值模拟揭示激光功率从 60 w 增加至 270 w 时单道 slm成形熔道形貌、熔池尺寸与温度、传热机制等熔池行为的基本特征;研究在 0.2 j/mm、0.3 j/mm 和 0.45 j/mm 线能量密度下不同激光功率和扫描速度组合对熔道形貌、熔池尺寸与传热机制的影响规律;结合熔道搭接理论模型计算激光功率 180 w 和扫描速度 600 mm/s 组合下无搭接缺陷的扫描间距理论临界条件约为 83 μm,并研究 80 μm、100 μm 和 120 μm 扫描间距下多道多层 slm 成形熔道搭接行为和演变规律。该模型可用于筛选工艺参数区间,提高工艺优化效率,为单层/多层成形的工艺试验提供指导。 ong jun, tang qian, luo zhichao, feng qixiang, nie yunfei journal of mechanical engineering 1. college of mechanical and vehicle engineering, chongqing university, chongqing 400044;2. state key laboratory of materials processing and die & mould technology, huazhong university of science and technology, wuhan 430074;3. school of advanced manufacturing engineering, chongqing university of posts and telecommunications, chongqing 400065

blob: study on regional continuous energy control scanning method for selective laser melting 摘要： 针对激光选区熔化(selective laser melting，slm)成形悬垂结构件中存在的翘曲、挂渣等成形质量问题，基于局部区域传热差异性和层间热量传递性研究成形过程中已凝固实体与粉末分布对温度分布的影响，从而对悬垂件的成形进行优化。建立了基于零件几何信息驱动的能量调控优化模型，通过识别模型的几何特征，根据局部区域内的凝固实体和材料粉末的比例计算能量影响因子，实现基于软件自适应调节的变工艺参数的定域定量扫描，最终实现区域能量连续调控与工艺优化。选取典型悬垂件进行316l材料的打印实验作为验证，结果表明相较于未优化的普通扫描方案，基于软件自动能量调控的优化扫描方案可以提高小于45°倾角的悬垂结构件的成形质量，成形40°悬垂结构件时，变参数成形的悬垂面面平均粗糙度sa(surface average roughness)达24.03 μm，相比定参数成形的sa为46.32 μm，表面光洁度明显提高；同时可无支撑成形8 mm跨度的水平悬垂件。 qin lin, zhang lichao, wang senlin, tang mingkai, shi yusheng journal of mechanical engineering 1. school of materials science and engineering, huazhong university of science and technology, wuhan 430074;2. school of machinery and automation, wuhan university of science and technology, wuhan 430081

title: Region Performance Matching Forming Method for Selective Laser Melting Based on Feature Recognition of Skeleton Line
authors: HE Junchi, ZHANG Lichao, WANG Senlin et al.
blob: region performance matching forming method for selective laser melting based on feature recognition of skeleton line 摘要： 对于激光选区熔化成形存在如薄壁和尖角等特征区域的零件，不同特征区域在真实服役场景下的性能需求和与之匹配的最佳工艺策略不尽相同。针对现有激光选区熔化工艺规划及加工软件中缺乏支持各类特征区域提取并匹配不同工艺策略的情况，提出一种基于骨架线特征识别的激光选区熔化区域性能匹配成形方法，实现薄壁、尖角和大平面等区域匹配性能需求工艺策略的一体化成形。通过仿真或实验确定各特征区域的性能需求，再提取切片轮廓的主骨架线，并依据其特征对切片轮廓进行区域划分，同时通过工艺数据库确定匹配各区域性能需求的工艺策略，将匹配性能需求的工艺策略赋予相应区域并打印成形零件。使用ti6al4v材料打印航空航天中常用的叶轮零件等比例缩小模型进行实验，确定叶轮的性能需求为中心处所需抗拉强度大和叶片处所需塑性好，提取叶轮切片轮廓并设置分区参数从而划分叶轮中心处和叶片处，然后将实验得到的工艺策略分别赋予叶轮中心处和叶片处并打印成形零件，最后对两处的微观组织进行分析，验证了方法的可行性。本项目所提出的基于骨架线特征识别的slm区域性能匹配成形方法可有效实现区域性能可调控零件的一体化制造，使零件在服役过程满足不同区域对性能的 该论文仅涉及lpbf工艺优化，未涉及生物医学材料的多孔结构、力学适配或骨整合，与用户研究方向的关联性较弱。 针对slm零件中不同特征区域（如薄壁、尖角）性能需求不同，现有工艺规划缺乏区域特征提取与匹配策略的问题。 提出基于骨架线特征识别的区域性能匹配方法，提取切片轮廓主骨架线进行区域划分，并通过工艺数据库赋予各区域匹配的工艺策略。 以ti6al4v叶轮为案例，成功实现了中心高强度与叶片高塑性的差异化工艺匹配，验证了方法的可行性。 通过打印叶轮缩比模型并进行微观组织分析进行了实验验证，但仅限于航空零件，无生物医学相关实验。 am_ti6al4v additivemanufacturing_slm he junchi, zhang lichao, wang senlin, tang mingkai, shi yusheng journal of mechanical engineering 1. school of materials science and engineering, huazhong university of science and technology, wuhan 430074;2. school of machinery and automation, wuhan university of science and technology, wuhan 430081

title: Analysis of Plume Motion Characteristics in Selective Laser Melting Forming Process Based on Image Semantic Segmentation and Graph Convolution
authors: LIN Xin, MAO Yangkun, FUH Ying Hsi Jerry et al.
blob: analysis of plume motion characteristics in selective laser melting forming process based on image semantic segmentation and graph convolution 摘要： 现有的研究中羽流已被证明与选区激光熔融加工过程有着密切关系且影响了最终成形质量，如何利用羽流等监测信息揭示选区激光熔融成形过程中熔融状态，是选区激光熔融成形过程监测被广泛关注的重要原因之一。为了更加完善地描述羽流信息，采用deeplabv3+网络对图像进行语义分割，并使用标记图法建立一维的羽流形态特征；同时结合时序信号，构建图卷积自编码器与分类器，提出一种基于图结构的羽流运动特征，并进行聚类，得到熔融状态分类，讨论加工过程中羽流运动特征和熔融状态的关系。采用图卷积编码羽流动态特征，实现特征建立与熔融状态识别，并通过输出图卷积表征值，对图卷积在羽流特征提取中的应用进行可解释性分析。结果表明，提出的羽流特征能够实现五类熔融状态的识别且准确率达到了81.52%，并通过可解释性分析了羽流动态特征与熔融状态的内在关系，为选区激光熔融成形过程中监测信号与成形质量映射关系研究提供了新的思路。 lin xin, mao yangkun, fuh ying hsi jerry, zhu kunpeng journal of mechanical engineering 1. precision manufacturing institute, wuhan university of science and technology, wuhan 430081;2. key laboratory of metallurgical equipment and control technology, ministry of education, wuhan university of science and technology, wuhan 430081;3. institute of intelligent machines, hefei institutes of physical science, chinese academy of sciences, hefei 230031;4. national university of singapore (suzhou) research institute, suzhou 215123

blob: accelerating black-box molecular property optimization by adaptively learning sparse subspaces molecular property optimization (mpo) problems are inherently challenging since they are formulated over discrete, unstructured spaces and the labeling process involves expensive simulations or experiments, which fundamentally limits the amount of available data. bayesian optimization (bo) is a powerful and popular framework for efficient optimization of noisy, black-box objective functions (e.g., measured property values), thus is a potentially attractive framework for mpo. to apply bo to mpo p 方法（稀疏高斯过程处理高维黑箱优化）理论上可迁移至fea代理模型，但领域差异大且未处理结构约束与uq。 分子性质优化面临高维离散空间和昂贵标注的挑战，贝叶斯优化虽适用但受维度灾难影响。 提出结合数值分子描述符与稀疏轴对齐高斯过程模型的方法，快速识别对性质建模最相关的稀疏子空间。 在多个基准和实际问题上显著优于现有方法，能在100次以内从超过10万候选分子中找到近最优分子。 仅在标准分子优化基准和计算模拟上进行验证，无真实实验或临床验证。 fea_surrogatemodelling chemistry_bayesianoptimization farshud sorourifar, thomas banker, joel a. paulson arxiv preprint

blob: beyond regrets: geometric metrics for bayesian optimization bayesian optimization is a principled optimization strategy for a black-box objective function. it shows its effectiveness in a wide variety of real-world applications such as scientific discovery and experimental design. in general, the performance of bayesian optimization is reported through regret-based metrics such as instantaneous, simple, and cumulative regrets. these metrics only rely on function evaluations, so that they do not consider geometric relationships between query points and gl 间接相关：贝叶斯优化是替代仿真的常用方法，但该文仅改进评估方式，未直接提升优化效率或处理用户需要的约束与uq。 传统贝叶斯优化性能评估仅基于函数值后悔度，忽略了查询点与全局解之间的几何关系，无法区分是否找到多个全局解。 提出了四个几何度量（精确度、召回率、平均程度、平均距离），并推导了无参数形式以消除额外参数的影响。 新指标能够提供比传统指标更细致的贝叶斯优化性能解释。 仅在合成问题上验证，无真实实验或应用场景的验证。 fea_surrogate_bayesian optimization fea_surrogate_metrics jungtaek kim arxiv preprint

title: Machine Learned Interatomic Potentials for Ternary Carbides trained on the AFLOW Database
authors: Josiah Roberts, Biswas Rijal, Simon Divilov et al.
blob: machine learned interatomic potentials for ternary carbides trained on the aflow database large density functional theory (dft) databases are a treasure trove of energies, forces and stresses that can be used to train machine learned interatomic potentials for atomistic modeling. herein, we employ structural relaxations from the aflow database to train moment tensor potentials (mtps) for four carbide systems: hftac, hfzrc, mowc and tatic. the resulting mtps are used to relax ~6300 random symmetric structures, and are subsequently improved via active learning to generate robust potent 与生物打印综述、髋关节植入物fea、代理模型或生物医学增材制造无直接关联。 利用大规模dft数据库训练机器学习原子间势，用于三元碳化物的原子级建模。 使用aflow数据库的结构弛豫数据训练矩张量势（mtp），并通过主动学习改进。 生成的势函数能够准确预测凸包和形成焓，与dft结果一致，并发现新稳定结构。 通过与dft结果对比验证，无实验或生物医学验证。 josiah roberts, biswas rijal, simon divilov, jon-paul maria, william g. fahrenholtz arxiv preprint

title: Approximating Numerical Fluxes Using Fourier Neural Operators for Hyperbolic Conservation Laws
authors: Taeyoung Kim, Myungjoo Kang
blob: approximating numerical fluxes using fourier neural operators for hyperbolic conservation laws traditionally, classical numerical schemes have been employed to solve partial differential equations (pdes) using computational methods. recently, neural network-based methods have emerged. despite these advancements, neural network-based methods, such as physics-informed neural networks (pinns) and neural operators, exhibit deficiencies in robustness and generalization. to address these issues, numerous studies have integrated classical numerical frameworks with machine learning techniques, in 该论文属于代理模型方法研究，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计，对用户的核心研究（如髋关节置换、生物打印）仅提供间接的数学工具参考。 现有神经网络方法（如pinns和神经算子）在鲁棒性和泛化性上存在不足，需要将经典数值框架与机器学习结合。 针对双曲守恒律，用傅里叶神经算子（fno）替代传统数值通量，并基于守恒律数值格式设计损失函数。 方法兼具传统数值格式和fno的优势，在鲁棒性、分辨率不变性和分布外样本泛化上优于标准fno。 仅通过数值算例验证，无实验或生物力学应用验证。 surrogate_modelling_fno pde_surrogate taeyoung kim, myungjoo kang arxiv preprint

title: Zero-shot Active Learning Using Self Supervised Learning
authors: Abhishek Sinha, Shreya Singh
blob: zero-shot active learning using self supervised learning deep learning algorithms are often said to be data hungry. the performance of such algorithms generally improve as more and more annotated data is fed into the model. while collecting unlabelled data is easier (as they can be scraped easily from the internet), annotating them is a tedious and expensive task. given a fixed budget available for data annotation, active learning helps selecting the best subset of data for annotation, such that the deep learning model when trained over that subset wi 该论文未涉及生物打印、髋关节植入物或fea代理建模，相关性极低。 深度学习方法通常需要大量标注数据，而标注数据耗时耗力。主动学习旨在预算内选择最佳数据子集以最大化模型泛化性能。 提出一种基于自监督学习的零样本主动学习方法，无需迭代过程，利用自监督特征表示进行数据选择。 在多个数据集上验证了方法的有效性，减少了标注成本。 仅在公开图像数据集上进行实验验证，未涉及生物医学或工程应用。 ml_activelearning abhishek sinha, shreya singh arxiv preprint

authors: Zhengfei Zhang, Yunyue Wei, Yanan Sui
blob: an invariant information geometric method for high-dimensional online optimization sample efficiency is crucial in optimization, particularly in black-box scenarios characterized by expensive evaluations and zeroth-order feedback. when computing resources are plentiful, bayesian optimization is often favored over evolution strategies. in this paper, we introduce a full invariance oriented evolution strategies algorithm, derived from its corresponding framework, that effectively rivals the leading bayesian optimization method in tasks with dimensions at the upper limit of bayes 该方法可提高fea代理模型的优化效率，但需补充约束处理与uq才能用于植入物设计。 高维黑箱优化中样本效率至关重要，尤其在评估代价高昂的场景下。 提出完全不变性的演化策略框架invigo，并实例化为多变量高斯上的不变可扩展优化器syncma。 syncma在mujoco、rover规划等高维任务中与领先贝叶斯优化方法竞争力强，样本效率优越。 仅在仿真基准任务上测试，无实验或临床验证。 fea_surrogatemodelling optimization evolutionstrategies zhengfei zhang, yunyue wei, yanan sui arxiv preprint

authors: Wei Qian, Chenxu Zhao, Yangyi Li et al.
blob: towards modeling uncertainties of self-explaining neural networks via conformal prediction despite the recent progress in deep neural networks (dnns), it remains challenging to explain the predictions made by dnns. existing explanation methods for dnns mainly focus on post-hoc explanations where another explanatory model is employed to provide explanations. the fact that post-hoc methods can fail to reveal the actual original reasoning process of dnns raises the need to build dnns with built-in interpretability. motivated by this, many self-explaining neural networks have been propose 该论文为纯机器学习不确定性方法，不涉及生物力学代理建模、fea采样效率或植入物设计，无直接相关性。 现有自解释神经网络缺乏对预测和解释的分布无关不确定性量化，且未能建立解释层置信度与预测层置信度之间的关联。 提出一种基于共形预测的不确定性建模框架，为自解释网络同时提供对解释和预测的不确定性估计。 实验证明该框架在分布无关不确定性建模方面表现有效，能生成高效且有效的预测集。 仅在标准机器学习数据集上实验验证，无实际工程或生物医学实验。 ml_uncertaintyquantification ml_explainability wei qian, chenxu zhao, yangyi li, fenglong ma, chao zhang arxiv preprint

title: Pontryagin Neural Operator for Solving Parametric General-Sum Differential Games
authors: Lei Zhang, Mukesh Ghimire, Zhe Xu et al.
blob: pontryagin neural operator for solving parametric general-sum differential games the values of two-player general-sum differential games are viscosity solutions to hamilton-jacobi-isaacs (hji) equations. value and policy approximations for such games suffer from the curse of dimensionality (cod). alleviating cod through physics-informed neural networks (pinn) encounters convergence issues when differentiable values with large lipschitz constants are present due to state constraints. on top of these challenges, it is often necessary to learn generalizable values and policies  方法学上属于pinn与神经算子方向，但应用领域为博弈论，不能直接迁移至植入物fea或生物打印。 解决参数化微分博弈中高维hji方程的求解效率和泛化问题。 提出pontryagin神经算子，引入基于协态损失的训练策略，利用前后向协态轨迹的差异来学习具有大lipschitz常数的值函数。 在参数化状态约束的博弈任务中，安全性能优于混合pinn模型。 仅通过数值实验验证，无真实实验或生物力学相关验证。 surrogatemodelling_pinn surrogatemodelling_neuraloperator lei zhang, mukesh ghimire, zhe xu, wenlong zhang, yi ren arxiv preprint

title: Clinical and radiographic outcomes of long monoblock, hydroxyapatite-coated stem in revision hip arthroplasty with extended trochanteric osteotomy: a multicenter study
authors: Peng Xin, Jianfeng Yang, Guangxing Chen et al.

blob: clinical and radiographic outcomes of long monoblock, hydroxyapatite-coated stem in revision hip arthroplasty with extended trochanteric osteotomy: a multicenter study background: the distally fixed stem used in revision total hip arthroplasty (rtha) with extended trochanteric osteotomy (eto) is subject to periprosthetic fracture, stem subsidence, and stress shielding. the prospective multicentric study aimed to assess the clinical and radiographic outcomes, and complications of using the corail revision stem in rtha with eto. methods: sixty-four patients undergoing rtha with eto using the corail revision stem between 2019 and 2020 were enrolled in the study.  仅为临床性能报告，未涉及假体-股骨界面力学、微动或应力遮挡的量化分析，对假体设计及有限元建模的参考价值有限。 评估corail翻修柄在翻修全髋关节置换联合股骨延长截骨术中的临床和影像学结果及并发症。 前瞻性多中心研究，纳入64例患者，通过影像学（engh评分、骨重塑等）和harris髋关节评分评估假体稳定性及功能。 平均随访34个月，eto愈合率高（62/64），髋关节功能显著改善（hhs从40.7升至82.1），股骨近端骨量恢复良好。 基于真实患者的临床与影像学随访，无有限元仿真或实验力学验证。 hip_implant_clinical_outcomes revision_tha peng xin, jianfeng yang, guangxing chen, yiming wang, yan wang journal of orthopaedic surgery and research department of orthopedics, chinese pla southern theater command general hospital, guangzhou, china

blob: chemically heparinized peek osseointegration remains one of the major challenges in the success of bone-related implants. recently, polyetheretherketone (peek) has emerged as an alternative material in orthopedic and dental applications due to its bone-mimicking mechanical properties. however, its bioinertness resulting in poor osseointegration has limited its potential application. so, the surface modification of peek with bone morphogenetic protein-2 (bmp-2) can be a potential approach for improving osseointegration. in  该研究与am生物医学材料方向中的多孔结构、lpbf制造及力学性能无关，但peek表面改性策略可能对生物材料改性有参考价值。 peek材料生物惰性导致骨整合差，需表面改性以提升其骨整合能力。 通过臭氧和紫外处理在peek表面接枝肝素，并负载bmp-2实现持续释放。 肝素化peek表面成功固定bmp-2并缓慢释放，显著促进mg-63细胞的增殖和成骨分化。 实验验证包括细胞增殖和成骨分化测试，但无动物或临床实验。 biomedicalmaterials_surfacemodification biomedicalmaterials_peek biomedicalmaterials_osseointegration meeichyn goh, kiyoon min, young ha kim, giyoong tae rsc advances school of materials science and engineering, gwangju institute of science and technology (gist) gwangju 61005 republic of korea gytae@gist.ac.kr.

blob: real-time 2d temperature field prediction in metal additive manufacturing using physics-informed neural networks accurately predicting the temperature field in metal additive manufacturing (am) processes is critical to preventing overheating, adjusting process parameters, and ensuring process stability. while physics-based computational models offer precision, they are often time-consuming and unsuitable for real-time predictions and online control in iterative design scenarios. conversely, machine learning models rely heavily on high-quality datasets, which can be costly and challenging to obtain within t 与fea代理模型方向相关，pinn方法可迁移至生物医学植入物增材制造中的温度场预测，但未直接涉及髋关节设计或生物打印。 金属增材制造中需要实时预测温度场以防止过热并调整工艺参数，而传统物理模型耗时，机器学习模型依赖高质量数据集。 提出基于物理信息神经网络（pinn）的框架，结合convlstm架构和物理信息损失函数，利用实时温度数据预测未来二维温度场。 在薄壁和圆柱/立方体零件中预测误差分别低于3%和1%，适用于不同几何形状、沉积路径和工艺参数。 仅通过模拟场景验证，缺乏真实实验数据支持。 fea_surrogatemodelling am_temperatureprediction pinn pouyan sajadi, mostafa rahmani dehaghani, yifan tang, g. gary wang arxiv preprint

authors: Alena Kopaničáková, George Em Karniadakis
blob: deeponet based preconditioning strategies for solving parametric linear systems of equations we introduce a new class of hybrid preconditioners for solving parametric linear systems of equations. the proposed preconditioners are constructed by hybridizing the deep operator network, namely deeponet, with standard iterative methods. exploiting the spectral bias, deeponet-based components are harnessed to address low-frequency error components, while conventional iterative methods are employed to mitigate high-frequency error components. our preconditioning framework comprises two distinct 可作为潜在数学工具，用于优化植入物有限元分析中的参数化求解器，但暂无直接关联。 加速求解参数化线性系统，通过将深度算子网络（deeponet）与传统迭代方法结合。 提出两种混合预条件策略：直接预条件（dp）和基函数提取（tb），分别利用deeponet处理低频误差，传统方法处理高频误差。 数值实验表明，基函数提取方法显著提高了krylov子空间方法的收敛速度，且鲁棒性强。 仅通过数值实验验证，未涉及实际工程或生物医学应用。 fea_surrogate_operator_learning fea_surrogate_parametric_systems alena kopaničáková, george em karniadakis arxiv preprint

blob: seqnas: neural architecture search for event sequence classification neural architecture search (nas) methods are widely used in various industries to obtain high quality taskspecific solutions with minimal human intervention. event sequences find widespread use in various industrial applications including churn prediction customer segmentation fraud detection and fault diagnosis among others. such data consist of categorical and real-valued components with irregular timestamps. despite the usefulness of nas methods previous approaches only have been applied to o 该论文研究nas在事件序列分类中的应用，与用户的生物打印综述、髋关节植入物设计、fea代理建模或增材制造研究均无关联。 针对事件序列分类任务，现有nas方法仅应用于图像、文本等领域，缺乏针对事件序列的自动化架构搜索方法。 提出seqnas，使用多头自注意力、卷积和循环单元构建搜索空间，并采用序贯贝叶斯优化和知识蒸馏进行搜索。 在事件序列分类任务上超越现有nas方法和经典架构，具有工业应用潜力。 仅在标准数据集上进行实验验证，无实际工业部署或生物医学验证。 igor udovichenko, egor shvetsov, denis divitsky, dmitry osin, ilya trofimov arxiv preprint

title: A Molecular Dynamics Study of Mechanical Properties of Vertically Stacked Silicene/MoS2 van der Waals Heterostructure
authors: Bishwajit Kar, Plabon Paul, Md Arshadur Rahman et al.
blob: a molecular dynamics study of mechanical properties of vertically stacked silicene/mos2 van der waals heterostructure silicene is an intriguing silicon allotrope with a honeycomb lattice structure similar to graphene with slightly buckled geometry. molybdenum disulfide (mos2), on the other hand, is a significant 2d transition metal dichalcogenide that has demonstrated promise in a variety of applications. van der waals heterostructures, which are created by stacking distinct 2d crystals on top of each other, are becoming increasingly important due to their unique optoelectronic and electromechanical properties. 该研究不涉及用户关注的增材制造、生物打印、髋关节植入物或仿真代理方法。 研究垂直堆叠的硅烯/mos2范德华异质结构的力学性能。 使用分子动力学模拟，在不同加载方向和温度下分析异质结构的响应和结构稳定性。 温度从100k升至600k时，异质结构的断裂强度降低40%，杨氏模量线性下降；mos2层主要决定弹性性质，硅烯层主导失效行为。 仅有模拟，无实验验证。 bishwajit kar, plabon paul, md arshadur rahman, mohammad jane alam khan arxiv preprint

venue: THE JOURNAL OF JAPAN SOCIETY FOR CLINICAL ANESTHESIA
blob: risk factors for discontinuation of intravenous patient-controlled analgesia in patients undergoing total hip arthroplasty 人工股関節置換術後における経静脈的患者自己調節鎮痛法（intravenous patient-controlled analgesia：ivpca）中止の危険因子を検討した．術後鎮痛として，持続投与とボーラス投与を併用したpcaポンプを用いてフェンタニルを投与した患者を対象とした．解析した268人のうち，ivpcaを中止した患者は95人であり，ivpca中止の原因は術後悪心・嘔吐が94人，錐体外路症状疑いが1人であった．ロジスティック回帰分析の結果，高齢，apfel score 3以上，ivpcaのフェンタニル投与速度0.35μg/kg/h以上がivpca中止の危険因子であった． 该论文与用户的研究方向（3d生物打印综述、髋关节植入物phd、fea替代方法、生物医学增材制造）均无直接关联。 探讨全髋关节置换术后经静脉患者自控镇痛（ivpca）中止的危险因素。 回顾性分析268例患者，使用逻辑回归分析年龄、apfel评分、芬太尼输注速度等变量。 高龄、apfel评分≥3、芬太尼输注速度≥0.35μg/kg/h是ivpca中止的独立危险因素。 仅有临床回顾性数据分析，无实验或仿真验证。 michinori nasu, hirofumi oishi, riho arai, toshiharu terasaki, takaya fukui the journal of japan society for clinical anesthesia department of anesthesiology, toyama prefectural central hospital

blob: effects of selective laser melting building directions and surface modifications on surface roughness of ti6al4v alloy abstract in this paper, the effect of building direction relative to the substrate (0°, 45°, and 90°) on the surface roughness of ti6al4v samples produced by selective laser melting (slm) has been investigated. after slm, the samples were subjected to different surface modifications, including acid etching (e) with hf, sandblasting (s) with al 2 o 3 and sandblasting + etching (se). surface roughness of the prepared samples were investigated by alicona infinite focus optical microscopy and scanni 报道了slm ti6al4v的表面粗糙度调控，与am生物医用材料（如髋关节植入物）相关，但未涉及多孔结构或力学性能。 研究选区激光熔化（slm）中构建方向（0°,45°,90°）和表面改性（酸蚀、喷砂等）对ti6al4v合金表面粗糙度的影响，以促进种植体骨整合。 采用slm制备不同构建方向的样品，并进行酸蚀（hf）、喷砂（al2o3）及喷砂+酸蚀处理，利用alicona infinite focus光学显微镜和sem表征表面粗糙度。 酸蚀处理在45°和90°方向增加粗糙度，0°方向降低；喷砂及喷砂+酸蚀有效降低所有方向粗糙度；90°酸蚀样品获得最佳粗糙度（ra=4.25±0.21 μm），有利于骨整合。 实验测量了表面粗糙度，有真实实验数据，但无力学或生物学验证。 am_biomedical_materials surface_roughness ti6al4v slm jános kónya, hassanen jaber, tünde anna kovács, hajnalka hargitai discover applied sciences doctoral school on materials sciences and technologies, óbuda university, budapest, hungary

title: Adaptive Uncertainty Quantification for Stochastic Hyperbolic Conservation Laws
authors: Jake J. Harmon, Svetlana Tokareva, Anatoly Zlotnik et al.
blob: adaptive uncertainty quantification for stochastic hyperbolic conservation laws we propose a predictor-corrector adaptive method for the study of hyperbolic partial differential equations (pdes) under uncertainty. constructed around the framework of stochastic finite volume (sfv) methods, our approach circumvents sampling schemes or simulation ensembles while also preserving fundamental properties, in particular hyperbolicity of the resulting systems and conservation of the discrete solutions. furthermore, we augment the existing sfv theory with a priori convergence results jake j. harmon, svetlana tokareva, anatoly zlotnik, pieter j. swart arxiv preprint

blob: brain-inspired physics-informed neural networks: bare-minimum neural architectures for pde solvers physics-informed neural networks (pinns) have emerged as a powerful tool for solving partial differential equations~(pdes) in various scientific and engineering domains. however, traditional pinn architectures typically rely on large, fully connected multilayer perceptrons~(mlps), lacking the sparsity and modularity inherent in many traditional numerical solvers. an unsolved and critical question for pinn is: what is the minimum pinn complexity regarding nodes, layers, and connections needed to  提出最小化pinn架构的方法，可能有助于提高替代模型的计算效率，但缺乏对生物力学设计约束和不确定性的直接处理。 传统pinn架构庞大且缺乏稀疏性和模块化，探索最小化神经网络复杂度以求解pde。 结合脑启发模块化训练（bimt），通过稀疏化和模块化逐步将全连接网络缩减为最小架构。 成功获得仅需少量神经元的极简pinn架构，并能展示高频问题需要更多神经元的谱偏置现象。 仅在合成pde基准问题中验证，无实际工程或生物力学实验验证。 pinn_minimalarchitecture braininspired_ml pde_solver surrogatemodeling_general stefano markidis arxiv preprint

blob: an experimental workflow for bioprinting optimization: application to a custom-made biomaterial ink bioprinting is an emerging technology with significant potential in biomedical fields, enabling the creation of highly customized, cell-laden constructs. despite the promise, achieving high-quality, reproducible prints remains challenging due to the lack of standardized protocols, which has hindered widespread adoption of the technique. in this study, we present a systematic bioprinting protocol designed to optimize the performance of an in-house photo-curable biomaterial ink composed of gelatin pablo martín compaired, elena garcía‐gareta, marı́a ángeles pérez international journal of bioprinting

abs0519 reliability and validity of the six-spot step test in determining fall risk in patients with total hip arthroplasty

abstract

background:

total hip arthroplasty (tha) is a widely performed surgical procedure to alleviate pain and improve mobility in patients with advanced hip osteoarthritis. however, long-term functional deficits such as reduced gait speed, impaired balance, and increased fall risk persist in many patients. these deficits emphasize the need for reliable tools to assess fall risk and guide targeted rehabilitation. the six-spot step test (ssst), originally validated in other pop 该论文仅关注全髋关节置换术后的临床功能评估，未涉及任何生物力学建模或植入物力学分析。 this paper is a clinical study on fall risk assessment using a step test, with no biomechanical modeling, implant stress analysis, or fea. 评估全髋关节置换术后患者跌倒风险的可靠工具需求 对61名术后患者进行六点步态测试，分析重测信度和效度 ssst具有优秀的信度和效度，10.68秒为最佳跌倒风险阈值 通过icc、bland-altman和roc曲线进行临床验证 to assess the reliability and validity of the six-spot step test (ssst) as a tool for fall risk identification in patients after total hip arthroplasty. sixty-one patients at least six months post-tha performed the ssst; reliability was evaluated via icc and bland-altman, validity via correlation with tug, fsst, and bbs. the ssst demonstrated excellent reliability (icc > 0.94) and a cutoff of 10.68 seconds identified fall risk with 73% sensitivity and 75% specificity (auc=0.82). clinical validation using standard balance and mobility measures with roc analysis. total hip arthroplasty fall risk six-spot step test clinical assessment reliability validity total hip arthroplasty 全髋关节置换术 six-spot step test 六点步态测试 fall risk 跌倒风险 reliability 信度 validity 效度 receiver operating characteristic 受试者工作特征 elif aygün polat, yusuf polat, yunus emre ozbilen, sevim acaröz candan, a. cirakli annals of the rheumatic diseases ordu university faculty of health sciences, physiotherapy and rehabilitation, ordu, türkiye

blob: a diffusion-based method for learning the multi-outcome distribution of medical treatments in medicine, treatments often influence multiple, interdependent outcomes, such as primary endpoints, complications, adverse events, or other secondary endpoints. hence, to make optimal treatment decisions, clinicians are interested in learning the distribution of multi-dimensional treatment outcomes. however, the vast majority of machine learning methods for predicting treatment effects focus on single-outcome settings, despite the fact that medical data often include multiple, interdependent o 该论文研究医疗治疗的多结果联合分布学习，与fea代理模型或植入物力学设计无关。 this paper focuses on causal inference for medical treatment outcomes using diffusion models, not on surrogate modeling for expensive physical simulations, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics design. 现有方法多处理单一结果，无法捕捉多医疗结果间的依赖关系 提出扩散模型dime，通过因果掩码和条件分布分解学习联合干预分布 能有效生成多结果联合分布，优于点估计方法 在多个实验数据集上验证联合分布学习效果 existing machine learning methods for treatment effect prediction typically handle single outcomes, ignoring the interdependence among multiple medical endpoints. we propose dime, a diffusion-based method that decomposes the joint interventional distribution into conditional distributions with causal masking to capture outcome dependencies. dime effectively learns the joint distribution of multiple outcomes, enabling uncertainty-aware decision-making beyond point estimates. the method is validated on multiple semi-synthetic and real-world medical datasets, demonstrating improved joint distribution modeling. diffusion model causal inference multi-outcome medical treatment uncertainty quantification diffusion model 扩散模型 causal inference 因果推断 joint interventional distribution 联合干预分布 uncertainty quantification 不确定性量化 multi-outcome treatment effects 多结果治疗效应 yuchen ma, jonas schweisthal, hengrui zhang, stefan feuerriegel arxiv preprint

authors: Eyhab Al-Masri

title: Targeting Metastasis: Exploring the Impact of Microbial Infections on Cancer Progression Through Innovative Biological Models.
authors: Mohamed A El-Tayeb
blob: targeting metastasis: exploring the impact of microbial infections on cancer progression through innovative biological models. infectious diseases, particularly viral infections, pose a significant threat to human health by contributing to cancer progression and metastasis. this review presents a novel perspective on how advanced biological models such as organoids, organ-on-a-chip systems, spheroids, and 3d bioprinting bridge critical translational gaps in research. these models replicate human physiological processes, allowing for the investigation of molecular mechanisms and the evaluation of novel therapeutics. this 该论文是关于微生物感染与癌症转移的综述，仅提及3d生物打印作为模型之一，不涉及ai在生物打印中的应用。 this paper is a biomedical review on metastasis and microbial infections; it contains no ai integration into bioprinting workflow, no experimental validation of ai models, and no autonomous decision-making in bioprinting. 探索微生物感染如何促进癌症转移，并利用先进生物模型填补研究空白。 综述了类器官、器官芯片、球体和3d生物打印等模型在感染相关转移研究中的应用。 强调了这些模型在模拟人类生理过程和评估新疗法中的价值。 未提供实验验证，为文献综述。 to understand how microbial infections drive cancer metastasis by leveraging advanced biological models that bridge translational gaps. this review discusses organoids, organ-on-chip, spheroids, and 3d bioprinting as tools to study infection-related metastasis. it highlights the potential of these models to replicate human physiology and evaluate novel therapeutics. no experimental validation; this is a review article summarizing existing literature. cancer metastasis microbial infection 3d bioprinting organoids review metastasis 转移 microbial infection 微生物感染 3d bioprinting 3d生物打印 organoids 类器官 organ-on-a-chip 器官芯片 spheroids 球体 cancer progression 癌症进展 mohamed a el-tayeb current microbiology department of botany and microbiology, college of science, king saud university, 11451, riyadh, saudi arabia. mali5@ksu.edu.sa.

title: End-to-End Probabilistic Framework for Learning with Hard Constraints
authors: Utkarsh Utkarsh, Danielle C. Maddix, Ruijun Ma et al.
blob: end-to-end probabilistic framework for learning with hard constraints we present probharde2e, a probabilistic forecasting framework that incorporates hard operational/physical constraints, and provides uncertainty quantification. our methodology uses a novel differentiable probabilistic projection layer (dppl) that can be combined with a wide range of neural network architectures. dppl allows the model to learn the system in an end-to-end manner, compared to other approaches where constraints are satisfied either through a post-processing step or at inference. pro utkarsh utkarsh, danielle c. maddix, ruijun ma, michael w. mahoney, yuyang wang arxiv preprint

blob: one sample is enough to make conformal prediction robust for any black-box model, conformal prediction (cp) returns prediction sets guaranteed to include the true label with high adjustable probability. robust cp (rcp) extends the guarantee to the worst case noise up to a pre-defined magnitude. for rcp, a well-established approach is to use randomized smoothing since it is applicable to any black-box model and provides smaller sets compared to deterministic methods. however, smoothing-based robustness requires many model forward passes per each input  soroush h. zargarbashi, mohammad sadegh akhondzadeh, aleksandar bojchevski arxiv preprint

blob: critical appraisal of fairness metrics in clinical predictive ai predictive artificial intelligence (ai) offers an opportunity to improve clinical practice and patient outcomes, but risks perpetuating biases if fairness is inadequately addressed. however, the definition of "fairness" remains unclear. we conducted a scoping review to identify and critically appraise fairness metrics for clinical predictive ai. we defined a "fairness metric" as a measure quantifying whether a model discriminates (societally) against individuals or groups defined by sensitive at 该文献讨论临床人工智能的公平性度量，与有限元代理模型方向无关。 this paper is a scoping review on fairness metrics in clinical ai, with no fea, surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification, and no transferability to implant/biomechanics design. 临床预测ai存在偏见风险，但公平性定义不清。 对2014-2024年文献进行系统综述，提取62个公平性度量。 发现度量标准碎片化，缺乏临床验证和不确定性量化。 综述性研究，未进行实际实验验证。 predictive ai in clinical practice risks bias, yet the definition of fairness remains ambiguous. a scoping review of 820 records from five databases (2014-2024) identified 62 fairness metrics from 41 included studies. the landscape of fairness metrics is fragmented, with limited clinical validation and overreliance on threshold-dependent measures. no experimental validation; the study is a literature review without empirical testing. fairness metrics clinical ai scoping review bias fairness metric 公平性度量 clinical predictive ai 临床预测人工智能 scoping review 范围综述 bias 偏差 discrimination 歧视 joão matos, ben van calster, leo anthony celi, paula dhiman, judy wawira gichoya arxiv preprint

blob: revisiting active learning under (human) label variation access to high-quality labeled data remains a limiting factor in applied supervised learning. while label variation (lv), i.e., differing labels for the same instance, is common, especially in natural language processing, annotation frameworks often still rest on the assumption of a single ground truth. this overlooks human label variation (hlv), the occurrence of plausible differences in annotations, as an informative signal. similarly, active learning (al), a popular approach to optimizing the 该论文研究主动学习中的标签变异问题，与有限元代理模型或植入物设计无关。 this paper focuses on human label variation in active learning for nlp, with no connection to fea, surrogate modeling, biomechanics, or implant design. 主动学习通常假设单一真实标签，忽略人工标注的差异。 综述了主动学习与标签变异的研究，提出了将人类标签变异纳入主动学习循环的概念框架。 展示了标签分解为信号与噪声的重要性，并探讨了大语言模型作为标注者的整合。 无实验验证，仅概念性讨论。 active learning often assumes a single ground truth, ignoring informative label variation from human annotators. the paper surveys existing work and proposes a conceptual framework to incorporate human label variation into the active learning loop, covering instance selection, annotator choice, and label representation. it highlights the need to decompose observed label variation into signal (human variation) and noise (annotation errors), and discusses the integration of large language models as annotators. no experimental validation; the paper is a conceptual review. active learning label variation natural language processing active learning 主动学习 label variation 标签变异 human label variation 人类标签变异 annotation error 标注错误 large language models 大语言模型 cornelia gruber, helen alber, bernd bischl, göran kauermann, barbara plank arxiv preprint

authors: Chenchen Wang, Jie Qi, Jiaqi Hu

authors: Agnideep Aich, Ashit Baran Aich, Dipak C. Jain

authors: Anya Shchetkina

title: Model order reduction techniques for the stochastic finite volume method
authors: Ray Qu, Jesse Chan, Svetlana Tokareva
blob: model order reduction techniques for the stochastic finite volume method the stochastic finite volume method (sfv method) is a high-order accurate method for uncertainty quantification (uq) in hyperbolic conservation laws. however, the computational cost of sfv method increases for high-dimensional stochastic parameter spaces due to the curse of dimensionality. to address this challenge, we incorporate interpolation-based reduced order modeling (rom) techniques that reduce the cost of computing stochastic integrals in sfv method. further efficiency gains are achieved ray qu, jesse chan, svetlana tokareva arxiv preprint

title: Estimating prevalence with precision and accuracy
authors: Aime Bienfait Igiraneza, Christophe Fraser, Robert Hinch
blob: estimating prevalence with precision and accuracy unlike classification, whose goal is to estimate the class of each data point in a dataset, prevalence estimation or quantification is a task that aims to estimate the distribution of classes in a dataset. the two main tasks in prevalence estimation are to adjust for bias, due to the prevalence in the training dataset, and to quantify the uncertainty in the estimate. the standard methods used to quantify uncertainty in prevalence estimates are bootstrapping and bayesian quantification methods. i aime bienfait igiraneza, christophe fraser, robert hinch arxiv preprint

blob: clear: calibrated learning for epistemic and aleatoric risk accurate uncertainty quantification is critical for reliable predictive modeling. existing methods typically address either aleatoric uncertainty due to measurement noise or epistemic uncertainty resulting from limited data, but not both in a balanced manner. we propose clear, a calibration method with two distinct parameters, $γ_1$ and $γ_2$, to combine the two uncertainty components and improve the conditional coverage of predictive intervals for regression tasks. clear is compatible with any  该论文提出了一个通用的不确定性量化校准方法，但未涉及有限元代理模型或生物力学应用。 this paper does not address fea surrogate modeling, constrained optimization, or biomechanical design; it is a general ml uncertainty calibration method. 现有不确定性量化方法难以同时校准认知不确定性和偶然不确定性。 提出clear方法，使用两个参数γ1和γ2分别校准偶然与认知不确定性，兼容多种估计器。 在17个数据集上平均区间宽度降低28.3%和17.5%，同时保持标称覆盖率。 在真实世界回归数据集上对比基线方法。 existing uncertainty quantification methods struggle to calibrate both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty simultaneously for regression tasks. clear proposes a calibration method with two distinct parameters, γ1 and γ2, to combine aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty components, compatible with quantile regression and ensemble methods. across 17 diverse real-world datasets, clear achieves an average reduction of 28.3% and 17.5% in interval width compared to individually calibrated baselines while maintaining nominal coverage. validation is performed on 17 real-world regression datasets against calibrated baselines, with additional experiments using deep ensembles and simultaneous quantile regression. uncertainty quantification calibration aleatoric uncertainty epistemic uncertainty regression uncertainty quantification 不确定性量化 aleatoric uncertainty 偶然不确定性 epistemic uncertainty 认知不确定性 calibration 校准 quantile regression 分位数回归 deep ensembles 深度集成 predictive interval 预测区间 conditional coverage 条件覆盖 ilia azizi, juraj bodik, jakob heiss, bin yu arxiv preprint

title: ViLU: Learning Vision-Language Uncertainties for Failure Prediction

blob: from images to properties: a nerf-driven framework for granular material parameter inversion we introduce a novel framework that integrates neural radiance fields (nerf) with material point method (mpm) simulation to infer granular material properties from visual observations. our approach begins by generating synthetic experimental data, simulating an plow interacting with sand. the experiment is rendered into realistic images as the photographic observations. these observations include multi-view images of the experiment's initial state and time-sequenced images from two fixed cameras cheng-hsi hsiao, krishna kumar arxiv preprint

blob: differentially private conformal prediction via quantile binary search most differentially private (dp) approaches focus on limiting privacy leakage from learners based on the data that they are trained on, there are fewer approaches that consider leakage when procedures involve a calibration dataset which is common in uncertainty quantification methods such as conformal prediction (cp). since there is a limited amount of approaches in this direction, in this work we deliver a general dp approach for cp that we call private conformity via quantile search (p-coqs).  与用户研究方向无关，不涉及有限元或代理模型 this paper does not address fea surrogate modeling, design optimization, or any biomechanical/engineering application; it focuses on differentially private conformal prediction for classification datasets. 差分隐私方法通常忽略校准数据集的隐私泄露 提出基于量化二分搜索的差分隐私共形预测方法p-coqs p-coqs在保证隐私的同时产生更小的预测集 在cifar-10、imagenet等数据集上实验验证 differentially private learning often overlooks privacy leakage from calibration data used in conformal prediction. p-coqs adapts a randomized binary search algorithm to compute dp quantiles during the calibration phase of conformal prediction. the method produces smaller prediction sets while maintaining target coverage and privacy guarantees across benchmarks. experiments are conducted on cifar-10, imagenet, and coronahack datasets, comparing coverage, efficiency, and robustness to privacy noise. differential privacy conformal prediction uncertainty quantification machine learning differential privacy 差分隐私 conformal prediction 共形预测 quantile binary search 量化二分搜索 uncertainty quantification 不确定性量化 prediction sets 预测集 ogonnaya m. romanus, roberto molinari arxiv preprint

authors: Zachary James, Joseph Guinness
blob: a framework for nonstationary gaussian processes with neural network parameters gaussian processes have become a popular tool for nonparametric regression because of their flexibility and uncertainty quantification. however, they often use stationary kernels, which limit the expressiveness of the model and may be unsuitable for many datasets. we propose a framework that uses nonstationary kernels whose parameters vary across the feature space, modeling these parameters as the output of a neural network that takes the features as input. the neural network and gaussian proces zachary james, joseph guinness arxiv preprint

blob: unconventional charge density wave in kagome metal bafe2al9 the charge density wave (cdw) is a macroscopic quantum state characterized by long-range lattice distortion and modulated charge density. conventionally, cdws compete with other electronic orders (e.g. superconductivity) and are suppressed under hydrostatic pressure. intriguingly, the kagome-variant metal bafe2al9, crystallized in a three-dimensional structure, exhibits pressure-enhanced cdw ordering, where the transition temperature (tcdw) rises from ~110 k to room temperature near 3.6 gpa. the liucheng chen, mingwei ma, xiaohui yu, fang hong arxiv preprint

blob: confidence calibration in vision-language-action models trustworthy robot behavior requires not only high levels of task success but also that the robot can reliably quantify how likely it is to succeed. to this end, we present a first-of-its-kind study of confidence calibration in vision-language-action (vla) foundation models, which map visual observations and natural language instructions to low-level robot motor commands. we establish a confidence baseline for vlas, examine how task success relates to calibration error and how calibration evolves 该论文涉及机器人视觉-语言-动作模型的置信度校准，与用户的研究方向（ai生物打印、髋关节植入物应力屏蔽、fea替代模型、增材制造生物医学）完全无关。 this paper focuses on confidence calibration in robot vision-language-action models, with no connection to fea surrogate modelling, implant biomechanics, bioprinting, or any biomedical engineering application. 首次研究视觉-语言-动作基础模型的置信度校准问题 提出提示集成和逐动作platt缩放两种轻量级校准方法 校准技术有效改善了vla模型的置信度估计 在机器人任务成功率与校准误差的关联上进行了评估 this study presents the first investigation of confidence calibration in vision-language-action foundation models for trustworthy robot behavior. two lightweight calibration techniques are introduced: prompt ensembles and action-wise platt scaling. the proposed methods improve confidence calibration and enable reliable uncertainty quantification in robot motor commands. validation is performed by analyzing task success rates and calibration errors over time in robot manipulation tasks. robotics vision-language-action confidence calibration robot behavior vision-language-action model 视觉-语言-动作模型 confidence calibration 置信度校准 prompt ensemble 提示集成 platt scaling platt缩放 uncertainty quantification 不确定性量化 robot behavior 机器人行为 robot motor commands 机器人电机指令 thomas p zollo, richard zemel arxiv preprint

title: Kourkoutas-Beta: A Sunspike-Driven Adam Optimizer with Desert Flair
authors: Stavros C. Kassinos
blob: kourkoutas-beta: a sunspike-driven adam optimizer with desert flair transformer neural networks are increasingly used for physics-based problems. in data-driven pde surrogates, training samples from varying boundary and initial conditions can cause erratic losses and spiky gradients; in physics-informed neural networks (pinns), stiff composite losses amplify this effect.   we introduce kourkoutas-beta, an adam-style optimizer where the fixed second-moment discount beta2 is replaced by a layer-wise dynamic value driven by a bounded ``sunspike'' ratio: the current stavros c. kassinos arxiv preprint

title: TCUQ: Single-Pass Uncertainty Quantification from Temporal Consistency with Streaming Conformal Calibration for TinyML
authors: Ismail Lamaakal, Chaymae Yahyati, Khalid El Makkaoui et al.
blob: tcuq: single-pass uncertainty quantification from temporal consistency with streaming conformal calibration for tinyml we introduce tcuq, a single pass, label free uncertainty monitor for streaming tinyml that converts short horizon temporal consistency captured via lightweight signals on posteriors and features into a calibrated risk score with an o(w ) ring buffer and o(1) per step updates. a streaming conformal layer turns this score into a budgeted accept/abstain rule, yielding calibrated behavior without online labels or extra forward passes. on microcontrollers, tcuq fits comfortably on kilobyte scale devi ismail lamaakal, chaymae yahyati, khalid el makkaoui, ibrahim ouahbi, yassine maleh arxiv preprint

title: Comparison of random field discretizations for high-resolution Bayesian parameter identification in finite element elasticity
authors: Pieter Vanmechelen, Geert Lombaert, Giovanni Samaey
blob: comparison of random field discretizations for high-resolution bayesian parameter identification in finite element elasticity we compare three random field discretization strategies for probabilistic identification of spatially varying material parameters in high-resolution finite element models. these strategies are (i) the karhunen-loève expansion, (ii) a wavelet expansion, and (iii) local average subdivision. the methods are assessed in the context of multilevel markov chain monte carlo applied to plane stress elasticity with high-resolution displacement observations. emphasis is placed on numerical efficiency, init pieter vanmechelen, geert lombaert, giovanni samaey arxiv preprint

title: Verifying Probabilistic Regions of Attraction with Neural Lyapunov Functions for Stochastic Systems
authors: Yun Su, Hans De Sterck, Jun Liu
blob: verifying probabilistic regions of attraction with neural lyapunov functions for stochastic systems leveraging a stochastic extension of zubov's equation, we develop a physics-informed neural network (pinn) approach for learning a neural lyapunov function that captures the largest probabilistic region of attraction (roa) for stochastic systems. we then provide sufficient conditions for the learned neural lyapunov functions that can be readily verified by satisfiability modulo theories (smt) solvers, enabling formal verification of both local stability analysis and probabilistic roa estimates.  yun su, hans de sterck, jun liu arxiv preprint

title: A Variational Physics-Informed Neural Network Framework Using Petrov-Galerkin Method for Solving Singularly Perturbed Boundary Value Problems
authors: Vijay Kumar, Gautam Singh
blob: a variational physics-informed neural network framework using petrov-galerkin method for solving singularly perturbed boundary value problems this work proposes a variational physics-informed neural network (vpinn) framework that integrates the petrov-galerkin formulation with deep neural networks (dnns) for solving one-dimensional singularly perturbed boundary value problems (bvps) and parabolic partial differential equations (pdes) involving one or two small parameters. the method adopts a nonlinear approximation in which the trial space is defined by neural network functions, while the test space is constructed from hat functions.  vijay kumar, gautam singh arxiv preprint

title: Physics-informed neural network solves minimal surfaces in curved spacetime

blob: physics-informed neural network solves minimal surfaces in curved spacetime we develop a flexible framework based on physics-informed neural networks (pinns) for solving boundary value problems involving minimal surfaces in curved spacetimes, with a particular emphasis on singularities and moving boundaries. by encoding the underlying physical laws into the loss function and designing network architectures that incorporate the singular behavior and dynamic boundaries, our approach enables robust and accurate solutions to both ordinary and partial differential equations  koji hashimoto, koichi kyo, masaki murata, gakuto ogiwara, norihiro tanahashi arxiv preprint

title: Improvements on uncertainty quantification with variational autoencoders
authors: Andrea Tonini, Tan Bui-Thanh, Francesco Regazzoni et al.
blob: improvements on uncertainty quantification with variational autoencoders inverse problems aim to determine model parameters of a mathematical problem from given observational data. neural networks can provide an efficient tool to solve these problems. in the context of bayesian inverse problems, uncertainty quantification variational autoencoders (uq-vae), a class of neural networks, approximate the posterior distribution mean and covariance of model parameters. this allows for both the estimation of the parameters and their uncertainty in relation to the observation andrea tonini, tan bui-thanh, francesco regazzoni, luca dede', alfio quarteroni arxiv preprint

title: Selective Risk Certification for LLM Outputs via Information-Lift Statistics: PAC-Bayes, Robustness, and Skeleton Design

blob: selective risk certification for llm outputs via information-lift statistics: pac-bayes, robustness, and skeleton design large language models often produce confident but incorrect outputs, creating a critical need for reliable uncertainty quantification with formal abstention guarantees. we introduce information-lift certificates that compare model probabilities to a skeleton baseline, accumulating evidence through sub-gamma pac-bayes bounds that remain valid under heavy-tailed distributions where standard concentration inequalities fail. on eight diverse datasets, our method achieves 77.0\% coverage at 2\% risk, 该论文专注于大语言模型的不确定性量化与认证，与fea代理建模及生物力学设计无直接关联。 this paper addresses llm output certification and does not involve surrogate modeling, finite element analysis, or implant/biomechanics design. 为llm输出提供可靠的不确定性量化与形式化放弃保证 基于信息提升统计量和子伽马pac-bayes界的稀疏基线比较方法 在低风险下实现高覆盖率，显著优于基线方法 在8个数据集上对比多种基准方法 large language models require reliable uncertainty quantification with formal abstention guarantees to mitigate confident but incorrect outputs. we propose information-lift certificates that compare model probabilities to a skeleton baseline using sub-gamma pac-bayes bounds robust to heavy-tailed distributions. the method achieves 77% coverage at 2% risk, outperforming baselines by 10 percentage points, and blocks 96% of critical errors in high-stakes scenarios. the approach is validated on eight diverse datasets, including natural language and safety-critical benchmarks, with graceful degradation under distribution shift. llm uncertainty quantification pac-bayes abstention risk certification uncertainty quantification 不确定性量化 pac-bayes bound pac-bayes界 abstention 放弃机制 distributional shift 分布偏移 large language model 大语言模型 sanjeda akter, ibne farabi shihab, anuj sharma arxiv preprint

blob: 3d bioprinting of a perfusable tumor microenvironment model to investigate perfusion and chemotherapeutic responses in ovarian cancer cells understanding the role of perfusion and chemotherapeutic response in solid tumors require advanced in vitro models that closely recapitulate the tumor microenvironment. addressing this need, we developed a perfusable three-dimensional (3d) gelma-gelatin-based tumor model embedded with a hollow microchannel to investigate spatial variations in skov3 ovarian cancer cell behavior and their response to carboplatin. this study aims to overcome the limitations of conventional 2d and non-perfused 3d cu md shahriar, marielena molinares, ganesh acharya, komaraiah palle, changxue xu international journal of bioprinting

authors: Kaustubh Sharma, Simardeep Singh, Parikshit Pareek
blob: decoupled-value attention for prior-data fitted networks: gp inference for physical equations prior-data fitted networks (pfns) are a promising alternative to time-consuming gaussian process (gp) inference for creating fast surrogates of physical systems. pfn reduces the computational burden of gp-training by replacing bayesian inference in gp with a single forward pass of a learned prediction model. however, with standard transformer attention, pfns show limited effectiveness on high-dimensional regression tasks. we introduce decoupled-value attention (dva)-- motivated by the gp propert kaustubh sharma, simardeep singh, parikshit pareek arxiv preprint

authors: Jake S. Rhodes, Scott D. Brown, J. Riley Wilkinson
blob: localized uncertainty quantification in random forests via proximities in machine learning, uncertainty quantification helps assess the reliability of model predictions, which is important in high-stakes scenarios. traditional approaches often emphasize predictive accuracy, but there is a growing focus on incorporating uncertainty measures. this paper addresses localized uncertainty quantification in random forests. while current methods often rely on quantile regression or monte carlo techniques, we propose a new approach using naturally occurring test sets and si 该论文专注于随机森林的不确定性量化方法，不涉及有限元代理模型或生物力学设计优化。 this paper does not involve finite element simulations, surrogate modeling for expensive physical simulations, constraint handling, or biomechanics/implant design contexts. 高可靠性场景需要评估模型预测的不确定性。 利用随机森林的邻近性度量构造局部预测区间和信任分数。 所提方法在回归和分类任务上取得具有竞争力的覆盖率和准确性。 在标准基准数据集上对比量化回归和拒绝分类指标。 to improve reliability of machine learning predictions in high-stakes scenarios by providing localized uncertainty estimates. a novel approach that constructs prediction intervals for regression and trust scores for classification using localized distributions of out-of-bag errors from nearby points based on random forest proximities. the proposed method achieves adjustable coverage and competitive accuracy-rejection trade-offs compared to existing uncertainty quantification techniques. the method is validated on standard benchmark datasets for regression and classification, comparing coverage and accuracy-rejection auc scores with baselines. random forests uncertainty quantification proximities machine learning regression classification uncertainty quantification 不确定性量化 random forests 随机森林 proximities 邻近性 prediction intervals 预测区间 trust scores 信任分数 out-of-bag errors 袋外误差 jake s. rhodes, scott d. brown, j. riley wilkinson arxiv preprint

title: Accelerating High-Fidelity Fixed Point Schemes with On-the-fly Reduced Order Modeling
authors: Philippe-André Luneau, Jean Deteix
blob: accelerating high-fidelity fixed point schemes with on-the-fly reduced order modeling a general method for accelerating fixed point schemes for problems related to partial differential equations is presented in this article. the speedup is obtained by training a reduced-order model on-the-fly, removing the need to do an offline training phase and any dependence to a precomputed reduced basis (e.g. a fixed geometry or mesh). the surrogate model can adapt itself along the iterations because of an error criterion based on error propagation, ensuring the high fidelity of the converge philippe-andré luneau, jean deteix arxiv preprint

authors: Mingyi Zheng, Hongyu Jiang, Yizhou Lu et al.

authors: Septimus Boshoff, Sebastian Peitz, Stefan Klus
blob: bayesian transfer operators in reproducing kernel hilbert spaces the koopman operator, as a linear representation of a nonlinear dynamical system, has been attracting attention in many fields of science. recently, koopman operator theory has been combined with another concept that is popular in data science: reproducing kernel hilbert spaces. we follow this thread into gaussian process methods, and illustrate how these methods can alleviate two pervasive problems with kernel-based koopman algorithms. the first being sparsity: most kernel methods do not scale  该论文关注动力系统的koopman算子理论，与fea替代模型或生物力学设计无直接关联。 this paper does not address fea surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification for expensive simulation sampling; it focuses on linear representations of nonlinear dynamical systems. 结合koopman算子与高斯过程缓解核方法在动态系统建模中的稀疏性与超参数优化问题。 统一高斯过程回归与动态模式分解，提出贝叶斯传输算子框架。 降低了计算需求并提高了对传感器噪声的鲁棒性。 理论分析，未提供数值实验或应用验证。 koopman-based methods suffer from scalability and hyperparameter tuning; this work incorporates gaussian processes to address these issues. a unified framework integrating gaussian process regression with dynamic mode decomposition for learning linear representations of nonlinear systems. the proposed bayesian transfer operator reduces computational cost and improves noise resilience. theoretical derivations without numerical or experimental validation. koopman operator gaussian process dynamical systems reproducing kernel hilbert space dynamic mode decomposition koopman operator koopman算子 reproducing kernel hilbert space 再生核希尔伯特空间 gaussian process 高斯过程 dynamic mode decomposition 动态模式分解 bayesian transfer operator 贝叶斯传输算子 sparsity 稀疏性 hyperparameter optimization 超参数优化 sensor noise 传感器噪声 septimus boshoff, sebastian peitz, stefan klus arxiv preprint

blob: identifying memory effects in epidemics via a fractional seird model and physics-informed neural networks we develop a physics-informed neural network (pinn) framework for parameter estimation in fractional-order seird epidemic models. by embedding the caputo fractional derivative into the network residuals via the l1 discretization scheme, our method simultaneously reconstructs epidemic trajectories and infers both epidemiological parameters and the fractional memory order $α$. the fractional formulation extends classical integer-order models by capturing long-range memory effects in disease progre achraf zinihi arxiv preprint

blob: safe planning in unknown environments using conformalized semantic maps this paper addresses semantic planning problems in unknown environments under perceptual uncertainty. the environment contains multiple unknown semantically labeled regions or objects, and the robot must reach desired locations while maintaining class-dependent distances from them. we aim to compute robot paths that complete such semantic reach-avoid tasks with user-defined probability despite uncertain perception. existing planning algorithms either ignore perceptual uncertainty, thus lacking c 该论文提出了一种基于共形预测的不确定性量化方法，可用于路径规划，但对fea代理模型或植入物设计无直接应用。 no fea or surrogate modeling for biomechanical design; no implant or structural mechanics application. 在未知环境中实现语义可达避免任务，需处理感知不确定性。 使用共形预测在线构建语义地图并量化不确定性，无需传感器模型。 所提规划器实现了用户指定的任务完成率，优于基线方法。 通过仿真实验验证任务成功率。 to enable robots to perform semantic reach-avoid tasks in unknown environments while handling perceptual uncertainty without known sensor models. a planner that constructs semantic maps on the fly and quantifies uncertainty using conformal prediction in a model-free manner. the proposed planner consistently achieves user-specified mission completion rates and outperforms baseline methods. extensive simulation experiments demonstrate the theoretical mission completion rates are achieved. conformal prediction semantic mapping path planning uncertainty quantification conformal prediction 共形预测 semantic mapping 语义地图 path planning 路径规划 uncertainty quantification 不确定性量化 reach-avoid tasks 可达避免任务 david smith sundarsingh, yifei li, tianji tang, george j. pappas, nikolay atanasov arxiv preprint

title: Bayesian Surrogates for Risk-Aware Pre-Assessment of Aging Bridge Portfolios
authors: Sophia V. Kuhn, Rafael Bischof, Marius Weber et al.
blob: bayesian surrogates for risk-aware pre-assessment of aging bridge portfolios aging infrastructure portfolios pose a critical resource allocation challenge: deciding which structures require intervention and which can safely remain in service. structural assessments must balance the trade-off between cheaper, conservative analysis methods and accurate but costly simulations that do not scale portfolio-wide. we propose bayesian neural network (bnn) surrogates for rapid structural pre-assessment of worldwide common bridge types, such as reinforced concrete frame bridges. tr sophia v. kuhn, rafael bischof, marius weber, antoine binggeli, michael a. kraus arxiv preprint

blob: coupling physics informed neural networks with external solvers the current work aims to incorporate physics-based loss in physics informed neural network (pinn) directly using the numerical residual obtained from the governing equation in any dicretized forward solver. pinn's major difficulties in coupling with external forward solvers arise from the inability to access the discretized form (finite difference, finite volume, finite element, etc.) of the governing equation directly through the network and to include them in its computational graph. this pose rahul halder, giovanni stabile, gianluigi rozza arxiv preprint

title: Learning to Solve Optimization Problems Constrained with Partial Differential Equations
authors: Yusuf Guven, Vincenzo Di Vito, Ferdinando Fioretto
blob: learning to solve optimization problems constrained with partial differential equations partial differential equation (pde)-constrained optimization arises in many scientific and engineering domains, such as energy systems, fluid dynamics and material design. in these problems, the decision variables (e.g., control inputs or design parameters) are tightly coupled with the pde state variables, and the feasible set is implicitly defined by the governing pde constraints. this coupling makes the problems computationally demanding, as it requires handling high dimensional discretization yusuf guven, vincenzo di vito, ferdinando fioretto arxiv preprint

title: Guided Uncertainty Learning Using a Post-Hoc Evidential Meta-Model
authors: Charmaine Barker, Daniel Bethell, Simos Gerasimou
blob: guided uncertainty learning using a post-hoc evidential meta-model reliable uncertainty quantification remains a major obstacle to the deployment of deep learning models under distributional shift. existing post-hoc approaches that retrofit pretrained models either inherit misplaced confidence or merely reshape predictions, without teaching the model when to be uncertain. we introduce guide, a lightweight evidential learning meta-model approach that attaches to a frozen deep learning model and explicitly learns how and when to be uncertain. guide identifies sal charmaine barker, daniel bethell, simos gerasimou arxiv preprint

blob: vector-valued reproducing kernel banach spaces for neural networks and operators recently, there has been growing interest in characterizing the function spaces underlying neural networks. while shallow and deep scalar-valued neural networks have been linked to scalar-valued reproducing kernel banach spaces (rkbs), $\mathbb{r}^d$-valued neural networks and neural operator models remain less understood in the rkbs setting. to address this gap, we develop a general definition of vector-valued rkbs (vv-rkbs), which inherently includes the associated reproducing kernel. our cons 该论文纯粹是函数空间和神经网络的理论研究，没有涉及任何有限元分析、代理模型、不确定性量化或生物力学设计问题。 this paper provides no application to fea surrogate modeling, no uncertainty quantification, no constraint handling, and no biomechanics context. 为向量值神经网络和神经算子建立严格的函数空间理论框架。 发展向量值再生核banach空间的一般定义和理论，并证明神经网络和算子属于该空间。 建立了这些函数空间上的表示定理，证明优化能恢复对应网络架构。 纯理论推导，无实验或数值验证。 to establish a rigorous functional space foundation for vector-valued neural networks and neural operators. a general definition of vector-valued reproducing kernel banach spaces is developed, and it is shown that shallow neural networks, deeponet, and hypernetwork architectures belong to these spaces. representer theorems are proved, demonstrating that optimization over these function spaces recovers the corresponding neural architectures. no experimental or numerical validation is provided; the work is purely theoretical. theoretical functional analysis reproducing kernel banach space neural operator representer theorem vector-valued reproducing kernel banach space 向量值再生核banach空间 neural operator 神经算子 representer theorem 表示定理 deeponet deeponet hypernetwork 超网络 shallow neural network 浅层神经网络 sven dummer, tjeerd jan heeringa, josé a. iglesias arxiv preprint

title: PDE Solvers Should Be Local: Fast, Stable Rollouts with Learned Local Stencils
authors: Chun-Wun Cheng, Bin Dong, Carola-Bibiane Schönlieb et al.
blob: pde solvers should be local: fast, stable rollouts with learned local stencils neural operator models for solving partial differential equations (pdes) often rely on global mixing mechanisms-such as spectral convolutions or attention-which tend to oversmooth sharp local dynamics and introduce high computational cost. we present fino, a finite-difference-inspired neural architecture that enforces strict locality while retaining multiscale representational power. fino replaces fixed finite-difference stencil coefficients with learnable convolutional kernels and evolves state chun-wun cheng, bin dong, carola-bibiane schönlieb, angelica i aviles-rivero arxiv preprint

authors: Etienne Gauthier, Francis Bach, Michael I. Jordan
blob: adaptive coverage policies in conformal prediction traditional conformal prediction methods construct prediction sets such that the true label falls within the set with a user-specified coverage level. however, poorly chosen coverage levels can result in uninformative predictions, either producing overly conservative sets when the coverage level is too high, or empty sets when it is too low. moreover, the fixed coverage level cannot adapt to the specific characteristics of each individual example, limiting the flexibility and efficiency of these 该论文涉及自适应保形预测方法，可用于不确定性量化，但未涉及有限元分析、替代模型或生物力学设计。 this paper does not address fea, expensive simulation sampling, surrogate modeling, constraints, or any biomedical/implant application; it focuses on statistical coverage calibration in conformal prediction. 固定覆盖水平的预测集无法适应样本难度，效率低下。 利用e值和事后保形推理，通过留一法训练神经网络优化自适应覆盖策略。 实现了数据依赖的覆盖水平，在保持统计保证的同时减少预测集大小。 在多个数据集上验证了理论覆盖保证和实际效率提升。 fixed coverage levels in conformal prediction produce uninformative sets that fail to adapt to individual example difficulty. we optimize an adaptive coverage policy via a neural network trained with a leave-one-out procedure on the calibration set, using e-values and post-hoc conformal inference. the method achieves example-dependent coverage levels with valid statistical guarantees, resulting in smaller and more informative prediction sets. coverage guarantees are proven theoretically, and practical benefits are demonstrated on multiple benchmark datasets. conformal prediction adaptive coverage uncertainty quantification machine learning conformal prediction 保形预测 adaptive coverage 自适应覆盖 e-values e值 post-hoc conformal inference 事后保形推断 prediction set 预测集 coverage level 覆盖水平 uncertainty quantification 不确定性量化 etienne gauthier, francis bach, michael i. jordan arxiv preprint

blob: generalized top-k mallows model for ranked choices the classic mallows model is a foundational tool for modeling user preferences. however, it has limitations in capturing real-world scenarios, where users often focus only on a limited set of preferred items and are indifferent to the rest. to address this, extensions such as the top-k mallows model have been proposed, aligning better with practical applications. in this paper, we address several challenges related to the generalized top-k mallows model, with a focus on analyzing buyer choices.  与有限元代理建模研究方向完全无关，纯偏好排序统计模型。 this paper is purely about statistical preference modeling with no application to fea, surrogate modeling, structural optimization, or uncertainty quantification in engineering design. 传统mallows模型无法处理用户只关注部分项目的真实场景。 提出了广义top-k mallows模型的采样、概率计算和参数估计算法。 在合成和真实数据上展示了可扩展性和准确性，并与多项logit模型比较。 通过合成数据和真实数据集进行数值实验。 the classic mallows model fails to capture real-world scenarios where users only focus on a limited set of preferred items. we propose a novel sampling scheme, an efficient choice probability algorithm, and an active learning method for the generalized top-k mallows model. the methods demonstrate scalability and accuracy on synthetic and real-world data, outperforming the multinomial logit model in predictive power. validation is performed through extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world choice datasets. mallows model ranked choices preference learning active learning mallows model mallows模型 top-k preferences 前k偏好 ranked choices 排序选择 active learning 主动学习 choice probability 选择概率 multinomial logit 多项logit模型 shahrzad haddadan, sara ahmadian arxiv preprint

title: Deep Jump Gaussian Processes for Surrogate Modeling of High-Dimensional Piecewise Continuous Functions
authors: Yang Xu, Chiwoo Park
blob: deep jump gaussian processes for surrogate modeling of high-dimensional piecewise continuous functions we introduce deep jump gaussian processes (djgp), a novel method for surrogate modeling of a piecewise continuous function on a high-dimensional domain. djgp addresses the limitations of conventional jump gaussian processes (jgp) in high-dimensional input spaces by integrating region-specific, locally linear projections with jgp modeling. these projections employ region-dependent matrices to capture local low-dimensional subspace structures, making them well suited to the inherently localized mo yang xu, chiwoo park arxiv preprint

title: PhysWorld: From Real Videos to World Models of Deformable Objects via Physics-Aware Demonstration Synthesis
authors: Yu Yang, Zhilu Zhang, Xiang Zhang et al.
blob: physworld: from real videos to world models of deformable objects via physics-aware demonstration synthesis interactive world models that simulate object dynamics are crucial for robotics, vr, and ar. however, it remains a significant challenge to learn physics-consistent dynamics models from limited real-world video data, especially for deformable objects with spatially-varying physical properties. to overcome the challenge of data scarcity, we propose physworld, a novel framework that utilizes a simulator to synthesize physically plausible and diverse demonstrations to learn efficient world models.  yu yang, zhilu zhang, xiang zhang, yihan zeng, hui li arxiv preprint

title: Uncemented hip resurfacing in patients over 65: 16-year outcomes from a large, single-surgeon series
authors: Dani Gaillard-Campbell, Thomas P. Gross
blob: uncemented hip resurfacing in patients over 65: 16-year outcomes from a large, single-surgeon series background: hip resurfacing is often reserved for younger, active patients due to concerns over implant durability and fracture risk in older patients. however, there is a lack of long-term data evaluating outcomes in patients over 65 years old at time of surgery. this study addresses this gap by directly comparing implant survivorship, failure and complication rates, and clinical outcomes in a younger control cohort from the same large single-surgeon series (> 6000 cases). methods: we queried a dani gaillard-campbell, thomas p. gross musculoskeletal surgery midlands orthopaedics & neurosurgery, pa, columbia, sc, usa. dani.gaillard@midorthoneuro.com

blob: cofinellm: conformal finetuning of llms for language-instructed robot planning large language models (llms) have recently emerged as planners for language-instructed agents, generating sequences of actions to accomplish natural language tasks. however, their reliability remains a challenge, especially in long-horizon tasks, since they often produce overconfident yet wrong outputs. conformal prediction (cp) has been leveraged to address this issue by wrapping llm outputs into prediction sets that contain the correct action with a user-defined confidence. when the prediction 该论文专注于基于大语言模型的机器人规划，与fea代理建模、植入物设计或生物打印无关。 this paper addresses llm-based robot planning with conformal prediction, not fea surrogate modeling, biomechanics, or implant design. 提升大语言模型在机器人规划中的可靠性，减少人工干预。 提出cofinellm，一种共形预测感知的微调框架。 在多个语言指令机器人规划任务中，预测集大小和求助率均有改善。 通过仿真和硬件实验验证，包括分布外场景。 to improve the reliability of llm-based planners and reduce unnecessary human interventions by incorporating conformal prediction awareness into finetuning. cofinellm, a conformal prediction-aware finetuning framework that explicitly reduces prediction set size during llm finetuning. consistent improvements over baselines in prediction set size and help rate across multiple robot planning tasks. evaluation on simulated benchmarks and hardware experiments with out-of-distribution scenarios. llm conformal prediction robot planning language-instructed agents large language models 大语言模型 conformal prediction 共形预测 robot planning 机器人规划 finetuning 微调 prediction set 预测集 help rate 求助率 jun wang, yevgeniy vorobeychik, yiannis kantaros arxiv preprint

title: Bayesian Uncertainty Quantification with Anchored Ensembles for Robust EV Power Consumption Prediction
authors: Ghazal Farhani, Taufiq Rahman, Kieran Humphries
blob: bayesian uncertainty quantification with anchored ensembles for robust ev power consumption prediction accurate ev power estimation underpins range prediction and energy management, yet practitioners need both point accuracy and trustworthy uncertainty. we propose an anchored-ensemble long short-term memory (lstm) with a student-t likelihood that jointly captures epistemic (model) and aleatoric (data) uncertainty. anchoring imposes a gaussian weight prior (map training), yielding posterior-like diversity without test-time sampling, while the t-head provides heavy-tailed robustness and closed-form ghazal farhani, taufiq rahman, kieran humphries arxiv preprint

title: A Risk-Neutral Neural Operator for Arbitrage-Free SPX-VIX Term Structures
authors: Jian'an Zhang
blob: a risk-neutral neural operator for arbitrage-free spx-vix term structures we propose arbiter, a risk-neutral neural operator for learning joint spx-vix term structures under no-arbitrage constraints. arbiter maps market states to an operator that outputs implied volatility and variance curves while enforcing static arbitrage (calendar, vertical, butterfly), lipschitz bounds, and monotonicity. the model couples operator learning with constrained decoders and is trained with extragradient-style updates plus projection. we introduce evaluation metrics for derivatives ter jian'an zhang arxiv preprint

title: Optimizing Chain-of-Thought Confidence via Topological and Dirichlet Risk Analysis
authors: Abhishek More, Anthony Zhang, Nicole Bonilla et al.
blob: optimizing chain-of-thought confidence via topological and dirichlet risk analysis chain-of-thought (cot) prompting enables large language models to solve complex problems, but deploying these models safely requires reliable confidence estimates, a capability where existing methods suffer from poor calibration and severe overconfidence on incorrect predictions. we propose enhanced dirichlet and topology risk (edtr), a novel decoding strategy that combines topological analysis with dirichlet-based uncertainty quantification to measure llm confidence across multiple reasoning pa abhishek more, anthony zhang, nicole bonilla, ashvik vivekan, kevin zhu arxiv preprint

blob: a framework of discontinuous galerkin neural networks for iteratively approximating residuals we propose an abstract discontinuous galerkin neural network (dgnn) framework for analyzing the convergence of least-squares methods based on the residual minimization when feasible solutions are neural networks. within this framework, we define a quadratic loss functional as in the least square method with $h-$refinement and introduce new discretization sets spanned by element-wise neural network functions. the desired neural network approximate solution is recursively supplemented by solving a 该方法可提升pde求解精度，但未涉及采样效率、约束处理或uq，需评估是否可迁移至生物力学代理建模。 this paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanics/implant design transfer. 提高神经网络求解偏微分方程的精度和收敛性。 提出基于单元神经网络的间断伽辽金框架，结合h-精化与残差最小化。 相比pinn，相对l2误差降低一个数量级，计算成本低。 通过数值算例验证，比较相对l2误差。 to improve the accuracy and convergence of neural network-based pde solvers by reducing residual errors. proposes a discontinuous galerkin neural network (dgnn) framework with element-wise neural networks and h-refinement for iterative residual minimization. the dgnn method achieves at least one order of magnitude improvement in relative l2 error over pinn with low computational cost. validated on numerical benchmark pde problems by comparing relative l2 errors against existing pinn algorithms. discontinuous galerkin neural networks residual minimization pde solving pinn comparison discontinuous galerkin neural network 间断伽辽金神经网络 residual minimization 残差最小化 h-refinement h-精化 least-squares method 最小二乘法 trefftz neural network trefftz神经网络 pinn 物理信息神经网络 relative l2 error 相对l2误差 long yuan, hongxing rui arxiv preprint

authors: Miao Li, Michael Klamkin, Pascal Van Hentenryck et al.
blob: constraint-informed active learning for end-to-end acopf optimization proxies this paper studies optimization proxies, machine learning (ml) models trained to efficiently predict optimal solutions for ac optimal power flow (acopf) problems. while promising, optimization proxy performance heavily depends on training data quality. to address this limitation, this paper introduces a novel active sampling framework for acopf optimization proxies designed to generate realistic and diverse training data. the framework actively explores varied, flexible problem specifications re miao li, michael klamkin, pascal van hentenryck, wenting li, russell bent arxiv preprint

blob: avaliação funcional da mobilidade e força muscular em paciente no pós-artroplastia total de quadril introduction: proximal hip fracture represents one of the most common orthopedic injuries in the elderly. in many cases, surgical repair is required, making it a frequent procedure, especially among older individuals compared to younger patients. considering the growing elderly population, hip fractures may become a major challenge for the future. physiotherapy is strongly recommended in the postoperative period of this type of surgery, initially with the aim of minimizing the deleterious effect 该论文是术后康复的临床综述，未涉及任何生物力学建模或植入物分析。 this paper is a clinical rehabilitation review with no biomechanical modeling, no stress/strain analysis, and no implant mechanics. 探讨术后物理治疗对全髋关节置换患者功能恢复的效果 系统文献综述，检索pubmed、scopus和scielo数据库 渐进抗阻训练、水疗和远程康复有效改善活动能力和肌力 文献综述，无实验验证 this review aims to identify effective physiotherapeutic strategies for improving mobility and muscle strength after total hip arthroplasty. a systematic literature review was conducted from 2018 to 2020 using pubmed, scopus, and scielo databases. progressive resistance exercises, hydrotherapy, and telerehabilitation consistently enhanced mobility, muscle strength, and overall functionality. the findings are based on a qualitative synthesis of selected studies, without quantitative validation. review clinical rehabilitation hip arthroplasty total hip arthroplasty 全髋关节置换术 physiotherapy 物理治疗 rehabilitation 康复 mobility 活动能力 muscle strength 肌力 dilma do socorro moraes de souza, joão henrique de oliveira, luiz henrique chota magalhães, tathiane barbosa cavalcante, bruno dias duarte revista fisio&terapia.

blob: fibrous bioinks for the bioprinting of anisotropic scaffolds with micro-and nanoscale organization as a novel approach for in vitro skeletal muscle engineering replicating skeletal muscle architecture remains challenging in 3d bioprinting, as conventional bioinks lack multiscale directional cues. herein, we propose a next-generation fibrous bioink composed of fragmented electrospun gelatin fibers (f-gfs), uniformly embedded in an alginate/gelatin hydrogel matrix (f-alg/gel). upon micro-extrusion bioprinting, shear-induced f-gf alignment enabled the fabrication of microfilament-based scaffolds with intrinsic anisotropy. the resulting constructs exhibite gerardina ruocco, elena marcello, camilla paoletti, massimo salvi, alice zoso international journal of bioprinting

title: Smart Manufacturing: MLOps-Enabled Event-Driven Architecture for Enhanced Control in Steel Production
authors: Bestoun S. Ahmed, Tommaso Azzalin, Andreas Kassler et al.
