blob: structured noise modeling for enhanced time-series forecasting time-series forecasting remains difficult in real-world settings because temporal patterns operate at multiple scales, from broad contextual trends to fast, fine-grained fluctuations that drive critical decisions. existing neural models often struggle to represent these interacting dynamics, leading to unstable predictions and reduced reliability in downstream applications. this work introduces a forecast-blur-denoise framework that improves temporal fidelity through structured noise modeling. t 该论文专注于时间序列预测，与有限元替代建模或生物医学植入物设计无直接关联。 this paper addresses time-series forecasting with structured noise modeling and does not involve finite element analysis, surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or any biomechanical/ implant design context. 改进多尺度时间序列预测的准确性和稳定性 提出模糊-去噪框架，结合高斯过程生成结构化噪声 在电力、交通和太阳能数据集上实现了多步预测的准确性和稳定性提升 在多个公开时间序列数据集上进行数值验证 to enhance the accuracy and stability of multi-scale time-series forecasting for real-world applications. proposes a forecast-blur-denoise framework that incorporates a learnable gaussian process module to generate structured noise for capturing long-range temporal structure. consistent improvements in multi-horizon forecasting accuracy and stability on electricity, traffic, and solar datasets. numerical benchmarks on standard time-series datasets (electricity, traffic, solar). time-series forecasting structured noise gaussian process blur-denoise framework time-series forecasting 时间序列预测 structured noise 结构化噪声 gaussian process 高斯过程 blur-denoise framework 模糊-去噪框架 multi-scale temporal patterns 多尺度时间模式 sepideh koohfar arxiv preprint

title: Enhancing Conformal Prediction via Class Similarity
authors: Ariel Fargion, Lahav Dabah, Tom Tirer
blob: enhancing conformal prediction via class similarity conformal prediction (cp) has emerged as a powerful statistical framework for high-stakes classification applications. instead of predicting a single class, cp generates a prediction set, guaranteed to include the true label with a pre-specified probability. the performance of different cp methods is typically assessed by their average prediction set size. in setups where the classes can be partitioned into semantic groups, e.g., diseases that require similar treatment, users can benefit from pr 该论文专注于分类任务的共形预测，不涉及代理建模或有限元分析，与用户的研究方向无直接关联。 it does not address surrogate modeling, fea, expensive simulation sampling, constraints handling, or any aspect of computational mechanics or biomechanical design. 减少共形预测集大小并提升用户对语义分组的满意度 在得分函数中加入类间相似性惩罚项，并理论证明其有效性 所提方法在多个数据集上持续减小预测集大小 在标准分类数据集上对多种共形预测方法进行实证比较 this study aims to reduce conformal prediction set size while accounting for semantic class structure to improve user utility. a modified score function incorporating a penalty for out-of-group errors is proposed, with theoretical analysis of its advantages. the class-similarity-based approach consistently reduces prediction set size across various cp methods and datasets. empirical validation on standard classification benchmarks using multiple models and cp methods. conformal prediction classification uncertainty quantification conformal prediction 共形预测 prediction set 预测集 class similarity 类间相似性 uncertainty quantification 不确定性量化 score function 得分函数 ariel fargion, lahav dabah, tom tirer arxiv preprint

blob: numerical modelling meets additive manufacturing: a path toward tailorable tissue engineering and functional biomedical devices abstract there is an urgent need for new generations of more functional biomedical devices in tissue engineering that can significantly improve patient health. the development of customised tissue alternatives to organ donation needs more research to ensure their quality, reliability, affordability, and sustainability. biomaterials are promising substances that can be used for biomedical devices due to their properties’ similarity to the nature of body organs and tissues. additive manufacturing  该综述讨论了数值建模与增材制造在组织工程中的应用，但未涉及ai与生物打印的具体整合。 this paper is a review that does not embed ai into any bioprinting workflow stage, lacks experimental validation, and does not advance toward autonomous decision-making in bioprinting. 需要更功能化的组织工程生物医学设备，以改善患者健康。 综述了数值建模（如tpms）与增材制造在支架设计中的应用进展。 为未来研究提供了定制化组织替代物的清晰路径。 作为综述，未进行实验验证。 there is an urgent need for more functional biomedical devices in tissue engineering to improve patient health and reduce reliance on organ donation. this review examines the integration of numerical modeling, particularly triply periodic minimal surface geometries, with additive manufacturing for scaffold design. the review outlines a pathway for future research to tailor cell differentiation and tissue growth through optimized scaffold architectures. no experimental validation is presented as this is a review paper. none review tpms numerical modelling tissue engineering scaffold additive manufacturing 增材制造 tissue engineering 组织工程 triply periodic minimal surfaces 三周期极小曲面 scaffold 支架 numerical modelling 数值建模 biomaterials 生物材料 bioprinting 生物打印 porosity 孔隙率 pooyan parnian, alberto d’amore macromolecular symposia department of engineering university of campania luigi vanvitelli  aversa italy

blob: uncertainty quantification and data efficiency in ai: an information-theoretic perspective in context-specific applications such as robotics, telecommunications, and healthcare, artificial intelligence systems often face the challenge of limited training data. this scarcity introduces epistemic uncertainty, i.e., reducible uncertainty stemming from incomplete knowledge of the underlying data distribution, which fundamentally limits predictive performance. this review paper examines formal methodologies that address data-limited regimes through two complementary approaches: quantifying 该论文从信息论角度讨论不确定性量化与数据效率，未涉及有限元仿真或代理模型，但其中的不确定性量化方法可能间接适用于代理模型中的不确定性分析。 this paper is a general review of uncertainty quantification and data efficiency in ai, with no application to fea surrogate modeling, no handling of constraints or optimization, and no validation on biomechanics or implant design problems. 数据稀缺导致认知不确定性，限制ai性能 综述贝叶斯学习、信息论泛化界、共形预测等uq方法 提供了数据稀缺下不确定性量化与数据效率的理论框架 理论综述，无实验验证 scarce training data induces epistemic uncertainty that limits predictive performance in domain-specific ai applications. this review surveys generalized bayesian learning, information-theoretic generalization bounds, conformal prediction, and synthetic data augmentation for uncertainty quantification and data efficiency. it presents a theoretical framework linking data quantity to predictive uncertainty and highlights finite-sample guarantees for uq methods. no experimental validation; the paper is a purely theoretical and methodological review. uncertainty quantification data efficiency information theory review uncertainty quantification 不确定性量化 epistemic uncertainty 认知不确定性 bayesian learning 贝叶斯学习 conformal prediction 共形预测 generalization bounds 泛化界 synthetic data augmentation 合成数据增强 osvaldo simeone, yaniv romano arxiv preprint

title: Latent-Autoregressive GP-VAE Language Model
authors: Yves Ruffenach
blob: latent-autoregressive gp-vae language model we investigate a fully latent autoregressive scheme based on a gaussian process (gp) integrated into a variational autoencoder (vae). in this setting, sequential dynamics are transferred from the observation space to a continuous latent space, while linguistic generation remains parallel through a non-autoregressive decoder. we present a complete methodological formulation, including a causal gp prior, a structured amortized posterior, and a training protocol based on a regularized elbo. empiric yves ruffenach arxiv preprint

european journal of histochemistry recreating physiologically relevant spinal cord models in vitro requires not only appropriate cell types but also structural and topographical cues that mimic native tissue. while 2d cultures fail to reproduce the spatial complexity of the central nervous system, 3d bioprinting strategies enable more realistic neural microenvironments. we aim to develop a 3d spinal cord model by combining murine cell lines or human stem cell–derived neural progenitors with a multi-material scaffold system. murine neuronal/astrocytic (ne-4c) and motor neuron-like (nsc-34) cells were embedded in gelatin methacrylate (gelma) hydrogels and layered on aligned polycaprolactone (pcl) microfibers produced by melt electrowriting via extrusion-based bioprinting. the matrix supported long-term viability, proliferation, and differentiation: neuronal (map2, βiii-tubulin) and glial (gfap) markers increased progressively over 14-21-28 days in vitro (div), confirmed by immunofluorescence and western blot, and spontaneous network activity was detected through calcium imaging. in parallel, human neural progenitor cells (npcs) derived from induced pluripotent stem cells (ipscs) were successfully differentiated and later cultured within a composite hydrogel composed of gelma and geltrex for 7, 10, and 14 div. the npcs expressed sox2 and nestin, confirming their neural progenitor identity, and exhibited a characteristic rosette- like morphological organization, indicative of early neuroepithelial architecture. over time, they showed high viability and progressive neuronal maturation, with map2, βiiitubulin, and synapsin expression suggesting neuronal interconnection and emerging network formation. this preliminary 3d system might represent a versatile and biomimetic platform for modeling spinal cord structure and function, with translational potential for studies on spinal cord injury, neurodegeneration, and physiologically relevant drug screening. the work was supported by fondazione crt and the european union – next generation eu within the prin 2022 program (d.d. 104 – 02/02/2022, ministero dell’università e della ricerca)

title: Selective Conformal Risk Control
authors: Yunpeng Xu, Wenge Guo, Zhi Wei
blob: selective conformal risk control reliable uncertainty quantification is essential for deploying machine learning systems in high-stakes domains. conformal prediction provides distribution-free coverage guarantees but often produces overly large prediction sets, limiting its practical utility. to address this issue, we propose \textit{selective conformal risk control} (scrc), a unified framework that integrates conformal prediction with selective classification. the framework formulates uncertainty control as a two-stage problem yunpeng xu, wenge guo, zhi wei arxiv preprint

title: Multi-Trajectory Physics-Informed Neural Networks for HJB Equations with Hard-Zero Terminal Inventory: Optimal Execution on Synthetic & SPY Data
authors: Anthime Valin
blob: multi-trajectory physics-informed neural networks for hjb equations with hard-zero terminal inventory: optimal execution on synthetic & spy data we study optimal trade execution with a hard-zero terminal inventory constraint, modeled via hamilton-jacobi-bellman (hjb) equations. vanilla pinns often under-enforce this constraint and produce unstable controls. we propose a multi-trajectory pinn (mt-pinn) that adds a rollout-based trajectory loss and propagates a terminal penalty on terminal inventory via backpropagation-through-time, directly enforcing zero terminal inventory. a lightweight lambda-curriculum is adopted to stabilize training anthime valin arxiv preprint

blob: fine-tuning of neural network approximate mpc without retraining via bayesian optimization approximate model-predictive control (ampc) aims to imitate an mpc's behavior with a neural network, removing the need to solve an expensive optimization problem at runtime. however, during deployment, the parameters of the underlying mpc must usually be fine-tuned. this often renders ampc impractical as it requires repeatedly generating a new dataset and retraining the neural network. recent work addresses this problem by adapting ampc without retraining using approximated sensitivities of the  该论文涉及控制优化而非生物力学或有限元代理建模，与本用户方向无直接关联。 this paper focuses on control and approximate mpc tuning, with no connection to finite element analysis, surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or structural optimization. 避免近似mpc在实际部署中因参数调整而需重新训练。 利用贝叶斯优化基于实验数据自动调整近似mpc策略参数。 在倒立摆和欠驱动平衡独轮车上实现优于标称ampc的性能。 在倒立摆和独轮车硬件平台上进行实验验证。 to enable fine-tuning of approximate mpc policies without retraining, addressing the labor-intensive manual adaptation of controller parameters. bayesian optimization is used to automatically tune the parameters of neural network approximate mpc policies based on experimental data. the proposed method achieves superior performance over nominal ampc on hardware experiments of an inverted cartpole and an under-actuated balancing unicycle robot. experimental validation is conducted on two robotic hardware platforms: an inverted cartpole and a balancing unicycle robot. approximate mpc bayesian optimization neural network control hardware experiment approximate model predictive control 近似模型预测控制 bayesian optimization 贝叶斯优化 neural network 神经网络 fine-tuning 微调 hardware experiment 硬件实验 henrik hose, paul brunzema, alexander von rohr, alexander gräfe, angela p. schoellig arxiv preprint

title: Improving Semantic Uncertainty Quantification in LVLMs with Semantic Gaussian Processes
authors: Joseph Hoche, Andrei Bursuc, David Brellmann et al.

title: Derivative-Informed Fourier Neural Operator: Universal Approximation and Applications to PDE-Constrained Optimization
authors: Boyuan Yao, Dingcheng Luo, Lianghao Cao et al.
blob: derivative-informed fourier neural operator: universal approximation and applications to pde-constrained optimization we present approximation theories and efficient training methods for derivative-informed fourier neural operators (difnos) with applications to pde-constrained optimization. a difno is an fno trained by minimizing its prediction error jointly on output and fréchet derivative samples of a high-fidelity operator (e.g., a parametric pde solution operator). as a result, a difno can closely emulate not only the high-fidelity operator's response but also its sensitivities. to motivate the use of difno boyuan yao, dingcheng luo, lianghao cao, nikola kovachki, thomas o'leary-roseberry arxiv preprint

title: Multivariate Uncertainty Quantification with Tomographic Quantile Forests
authors: Takuya Kanazawa
blob: multivariate uncertainty quantification with tomographic quantile forests quantifying predictive uncertainty is essential for safe and trustworthy real-world ai deployment. yet, fully nonparametric estimation of conditional distributions remains challenging for multivariate targets. we propose tomographic quantile forests (tqf), a nonparametric, uncertainty-aware, tree-based regression model for multivariate targets. tqf learns conditional quantiles of directional projections $\mathbf{n}^{\top}\mathbf{y}$ as functions of the input $\mathbf{x}$ and the unit direction $ takuya kanazawa arxiv preprint

blob: robust causal directionality inference in quantum inference under mnar observation and high-dimensional noise in quantum mechanics, observation actively shapes the system, paralleling the statistical notion of missing not at random (mnar). this study introduces a unified framework for \textbf{robust causal directionality inference} in quantum engineering, determining whether relations are system$\to$observation, observation$\to$system, or bidirectional.   the method integrates cvae-based latent constraints, mnar-aware selection models, gee-stabilized regression, penalized empirical likelihood, and bayes joonsung kang arxiv preprint

title: BayesSum: Bayesian Quadrature in Discrete Spaces
authors: Sophia Seulkee Kang, François-Xavier Briol, Toni Karvonen et al.
blob: bayessum: bayesian quadrature in discrete spaces this paper addresses the challenging computational problem of estimating intractable expectations over discrete domains. existing approaches, including monte carlo and russian roulette estimators, are consistent but often require a large number of samples to achieve accurate results. we propose a novel estimator, \emph{bayessum}, which is an extension of bayesian quadrature to discrete domains. it is more sample efficient than alternatives due to its ability to make use of prior information abou sophia seulkee kang, françois-xavier briol, toni karvonen, zonghao chen arxiv preprint

authors: Peng Fan, Guofei Pang
blob: convolutional-neural-operator-based transfer learning for solving pdes convolutional neural operator is a cnn-based architecture recently proposed to enforce structure-preserving continuous-discrete equivalence and enable the genuine, alias-free learning of solution operators of pdes. this neural operator was demonstrated to outperform for certain cases some baseline models such as deeponet, fourier neural operator, and galerkin transformer in terms of surrogate accuracy. the convolutional neural operator, however, seems not to be validated for few-shot learning. w peng fan, guofei pang arxiv preprint

blob: learning to feel the future: dreamtacvla for contact-rich manipulation vision-language-action (vla) models have shown remarkable generalization by mapping web-scale knowledge to robotic control, yet they remain blind to physical contact. consequently, they struggle with contact-rich manipulation tasks that require reasoning about force, texture, and slip. while some approaches incorporate low-dimensional tactile signals, they fail to capture the high-resolution dynamics essential for such interactions. to address this limitation, we introduce dreamtacvla, a framewo 该论文关注机器人触觉操作，与生物打印流程无关。 this paper does not address any stage of bioprinting, lacks biomedical context, and involves no additive manufacturing or biomaterial deposition. 视觉-语言-动作模型缺乏对物理接触的感知，难以完成需要力、纹理和滑移推理的操控任务。 提出dreamtacvla框架，通过层次化空间对齐损失和触觉世界模型，将高分辨率触觉图像与多视角视觉融合。 在接触密集型操控任务中，成功率最高达95%，超越现有vla基线。 结合数字孪生和真实实验的大规模混合数据集进行训练和测试。 vision-language-action models fail in contact-rich tasks due to lack of tactile sensing for force, texture, and slip reasoning. dreamtacvla integrates high-resolution tactile images with multi-view vision using hierarchical spatial alignment loss and a tactile world model to predict future tactile states. it achieves up to 95% success in contact-rich manipulation tasks, outperforming state-of-the-art vla baselines. validation uses a hybrid dataset from digital twin simulations and real-world experiments. robotics tactile sensing vision-language-action contact-rich manipulation vision-language-action (vla) model 视觉-语言-动作模型 tactile sensing 触觉感知 contact-rich manipulation 接触密集型操作 hierarchical spatial alignment 层次化空间对齐 tactile world model 触觉世界模型 digital twin 数字孪生 guo ye, zexi zhang, xu zhao, shang wu, haoran lu arxiv preprint

title: Iterative Data-Consistent Inversion with Multiple Push-forward Constraints
authors: Tianyi Jiang, Troy Butler, Timothy Wildey et al.
blob: iterative data-consistent inversion with multiple push-forward constraints a foundational challenge in uncertainty quantification involves estimating a probability measure on the space of uncertain parameters such that its push-forward through a computational model matches an observed probability measure on the output data associated with quantities of interest (qoi). when multiple, distinct sets of observational data are available, the desired parameter measure should simultaneously satisfy multiple push-forward constraints associated with various subsets of the qoi.  tianyi jiang, troy butler, timothy wildey, tim kutta, haonan wang arxiv preprint

blob: healthmamba: an uncertainty-aware spatiotemporal graph state space model for effective and reliable healthcare facility visit prediction healthcare facility visit prediction is essential for optimizing healthcare resource allocation and informing public health policy. despite advanced machine learning methods being employed for better prediction performance, existing works usually formulate this task as a time-series forecasting problem without considering the intrinsic spatial dependencies of different types of healthcare facilities, and they also fail to provide reliable predictions under abnormal situations such as public emer 该论文关于医疗设施访问预测，不涉及有限元分析或植入物设计，方法难以直接迁移。 this paper does not involve finite element analysis, structural mechanics, implant design, or biomechanics; it is purely a spatiotemporal forecasting problem in public health. 现有医疗设施访问预测忽略空间依赖且异常情况下不可靠。 提出healthmamba，集成时空编码器、图状态空间模型和不确定性量化。 在四个州数据集上预测精度提升6%，不确定性量化提升3.5%。 在加州、纽约、德克萨斯和佛罗里达的真实数据集上验证。 current healthcare visit prediction models ignore spatial dependencies and fail under abnormal conditions like public emergencies. we propose healthmamba, a framework with a unified spatiotemporal encoder, a graph state space model (graphmamba), and comprehensive uncertainty quantification. healthmamba achieves ~6% improvement in prediction accuracy and ~3.5% improvement in uncertainty quantification over state-of-the-art on four large-scale datasets. the model is validated on real-world healthcare datasets from california, new york, texas, and florida. healthcare facility visit prediction spatiotemporal forecasting graph state space model uncertainty quantification healthcare facility visit prediction 医疗设施访问预测 spatiotemporal modeling 时空建模 graph state space model 图状态空间模型 uncertainty quantification 不确定性量化 public health 公共卫生 dahai yu, lin jiang, rongchao xu, guang wang arxiv preprint

blob: elas3d-xtal: an openmp-accelerated crystal elasticity solver with automated experiment-driven microstructure generation this paper introduces elas3d-xtal, a high-performance fortran/openmp upgrade of the nist elas3d voxel-based finite element solver for computing 3d elastic fields in polycrystals with defects. the code supports crystal anisotropy by precomputing rotated stiffness tensors from user-specified orientations and solves the equilibrium problem with a matrix-free, openmp-parallel preconditioned conjugate-gradient (pcg) method using a point-block jacobi preconditioner. on a single shared-memory multicore juyoung jeong, veera sundararaghavan arxiv preprint

blob: gradient networks for universal magnetic modeling of synchronous machines this paper presents a physics-informed neural network approach for dynamic modeling of saturable synchronous machines, including cases with spatial harmonics. we introduce an architecture that incorporates gradient networks directly into the fundamental machine equations, enabling accurate modeling of the nonlinear and coupled electromagnetic constitutive relationship. by learning the gradient of the magnetic field energy, the model inherently satisfies energy balance (reciprocity conditions). t junyi li, tim foissner, floran martin, antti piippo, marko hinkkanen arxiv preprint

blob: conformal risk control for non-monotonic losses conformal risk control is an extension of conformal prediction for controlling risk functions beyond miscoverage. the original algorithm controls the expected value of a loss that is monotonic in a one-dimensional parameter. here, we present risk control guarantees for generic algorithms applied to possibly non-monotonic losses with multidimensional parameters. the guarantees depend on the stability of the algorithm -- unstable algorithms have looser guarantees. we give applications of this tech 该论文关注共形风险控制和非单调损失，与有限元代理建模方向无关。 this paper does not address fea surrogate modeling, sampling efficiency, constraints, or uncertainty quantification for simulation; it focuses on statistical risk control for machine learning losses. 扩展共形风险控制至非单调损失和多维参数。 提出稳定性依赖的泛化保证算法。 在选择性分类、分割和去偏任务中验证。 数值实验和案例分析。 extend conformal risk control to handle non-monotonic losses and multidimensional parameters. provide risk control guarantees that depend on algorithmic stability. applications to selective classification, tumor segmentation control, and fairness debiasing. demonstrated through multiple case studies and numerical experiments. anastasios n. angelopoulos arxiv preprint

title: Unlearning Noise in PINNs: A Selective Pruning Framework for PDE Inverse Problems
authors: Yongsheng Chen, Yong Chen, Wei Guo et al.
blob: unlearning noise in pinns: a selective pruning framework for pde inverse problems physics-informed neural networks (pinns) provide a promising framework for solving inverse problems governed by partial differential equations (pdes) by integrating observational data and physical constraints in a unified optimization objective. however, the ill-posed nature of pde inverse problems makes them highly sensitive to noise. even a small fraction of corrupted observations can distort internal neural representations, severely impairing accuracy and destabilizing training. motivated by  该论文涉及物理信息神经网络中的噪声鲁棒性，但与fea替代模型的采样效率、约束处理或生物力学应用无关。 this paper focuses on denoising pinns for inverse problems, not on surrogate modeling for design optimization, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanics transferability. 解决pinn在逆问题中对噪声敏感的问题 提出选择性剪枝框架p-pinn，基于神经元重要性移除噪声相关神经元 相对误差降低高达96.6%，显著提升鲁棒性和精度 在多个pde逆问题基准上进行数值实验验证 physics-informed neural networks are highly sensitive to corrupted observations in inverse problems, motivating a mechanism to unlearn noise effects. p-pinn applies a joint residual-data fidelity indicator to partition data, introduces a bias-based neuron importance measure, and iteratively prunes noise-sensitive neurons before fine-tuning on reliable data. the proposed framework achieves up to 96.6% reduction in relative error compared to baseline pinns across benchmarks. numerical experiments on extensive pde inverse-problem benchmarks demonstrate improved robustness and accuracy under noisy conditions. pinn noise robustness pruning inverse problems machine unlearning physics-informed neural network 物理信息神经网络 inverse problem 逆问题 selective pruning 选择性剪枝 noise robustness 噪声鲁棒性 machine unlearning 机器遗忘 neuron importance 神经元重要性 data fidelity 数据保真度 yongsheng chen, yong chen, wei guo, xinghui zhong arxiv preprint

title: On the Equivalence of Random Network Distillation, Deep Ensembles, and Bayesian Inference
authors: Moritz A. Zanger, Yijun Wu, Pascal R. Van der Vaart et al.
blob: on the equivalence of random network distillation, deep ensembles, and bayesian inference uncertainty quantification is central to safe and efficient deployments of deep learning models, yet many computationally practical methods lack lacking rigorous theoretical motivation. random network distillation (rnd) is a lightweight technique that measures novelty via prediction errors against a fixed random target. while empirically effective, it has remained unclear what uncertainties rnd measures and how its estimates relate to other approaches, e.g. bayesian inference or deep ensembles.  moritz a. zanger, yijun wu, pascal r. van der vaart, wendelin böhmer, matthijs t. j. spaan arxiv preprint

blob: a bayesian framework for post-disruption travel time prediction in metro networks disruptions are an inherent feature of transportation systems, occurring unpredictably and with varying durations. even after an incident is reported as resolved, disruptions can induce irregular train operations that generate substantial uncertainty in passenger waiting and travel times. accurately forecasting post-disruption travel times therefore remains a critical challenge for transit operators and passenger information systems. this paper develops a bayesian spatiotemporal modeling framewo 该论文研究地铁网络的中断后旅行时间预测，与生物力学fea代理建模方向无关。 this paper addresses transportation travel time prediction, with no fea, no surrogate modeling for engineering design, no contact mechanics, and no biomedical or implant context. 地铁中断后旅行时间预测困难 贝叶斯时空模型捕捉列车交互与非高斯分布 偏斜-t模型在长距离预测中表现最佳 蒙特利尔地铁实测数据验证 accurately forecasting post-disruption travel times in metro networks is critical for transit operators and passenger information systems. a bayesian spatiotemporal framework with moving-average error structure and skew-normal/skew-t distributions is developed to model post-disruption travel times. the skew-t model outperforms baselines in both point prediction and uncertainty quantification, especially for longer journeys. the framework is validated using high-resolution track-occupancy and disruption log data from the montréal metro system. shayan nazemi, aurélie labbe, stefan steiner, pratheepa jeganathan, martin trépanier arxiv preprint

blob: loboost: fast model-native local conformal prediction for gradient-boosted trees gradient-boosted decision trees are among the strongest off-the-shelf predictors for tabular regression, but point predictions alone do not quantify uncertainty. conformal prediction provides distribution-free marginal coverage, yet split conformal uses a single global residual quantile and can be poorly adaptive under heteroscedasticity. methods that improve adaptivity typically fit auxiliary nuisance models or introduce additional data splits/partitions to learn the conformal score, increasing vagner santos, victor coscrato, luben cabezas, rafael izbicki, thiago ramos arxiv preprint

title: Surrogate models for Rock-Fluid Interaction: A Grid-Size-Invariant Approach
authors: Nathalie C. Pinheiro, Donghu Guo, Hannah P. Menke et al.
blob: surrogate models for rock-fluid interaction: a grid-size-invariant approach modelling rock-fluid interaction requires solving a set of partial differential equations (pdes) to predict the flow behaviour and the reactions of the fluid with the rock on the interfaces. conventional high-fidelity numerical models require a high resolution to obtain reliable results, resulting in huge computational expense. this restricts the applicability of these models for multi-query problems, such as uncertainty quantification and optimisation, which require running numerous scenarios.  nathalie c. pinheiro, donghu guo, hannah p. menke, aniket c. joshi, claire e. heaney arxiv preprint

blob: global river forecasting with a topology-informed ai foundation model river systems operate as inherently interconnected continuous networks, meaning river hydrodynamic simulation ought to be a systemic process. however, widespread hydrology data scarcity often restricts data-driven forecasting to isolated predictions. to achieve systemic simulation and reduce reliance on river observations, we present graphrivercast (grc), a topology-informed ai foundation model designed to simulate multivariate river hydrodynamics in global river systems. grc is capable of opera 该论文研究的是河流水文模拟，与fea代理建模或生物力学植入物设计完全无关。 this paper addresses river hydrodynamic simulation, not fea surrogate modeling for biomedical/implant applications; it lacks mechanical constraints, uncertainty quantification, and biomechanics context. 开发无需历史数据即可进行全球河流预测的模型。 利用拓扑感知的神经算子架构，通过预训练和微调实现跨尺度模拟。 冷启动模式下nse达0.82，优于物理模型和局部ai模型。 通过全球伪后报和消融实验验证模型性能。 to develop a global river forecasting model that operates without historical observations by leveraging topological information. a topology-informed neural operator architecture is employed, with pre-training on global data and fine-tuning for local adaptation. the model achieves an nse of approximately 0.82 in cold-start mode and outperforms physics-based and locally-trained baselines. validation is performed via global pseudo-hindcasts and ablation studies demonstrating the importance of topological encoding. river forecasting neural operator topology encoding foundation model hydrology neural operator 神经算子 river forecasting 河流预测 topology encoding 拓扑编码 foundation model 基础模型 hydrology 水文学 hancheng ren, gang zhao, shuo wang, louise slater, dai yamazaki arxiv preprint

title: 4CPS-053 Reducing oxycodone prescription and use in orthopaedic patients after hip or knee arthroplasty: a pre-post intervention study
authors: M Phaff, R Geuze, Barbara Maat
blob:
4cps-053 reducing oxycodone prescription and use in orthopaedic patients after hip or knee arthroplasty: a pre-post intervention study

background and importance

surgical procedures such as total knee arthroplasty (tka) and total hip arthroplasty (tha) are associated with risks of long-term opioid use. implementing interventions that effectively reduce these risks remains a challenge.

aim and objectives

to assess the effect of a multifaceted intervention at patient-, nurse- and prescriber-level on postoperative prescribing and use of oxycodone after discharge in tka and tha patients.

blob: physically accurate differentiable inverse rendering for radio frequency digital twin digital twins, virtual simulated replicas of physical scenes, are transforming system design across industries. however, their potential in radio frequency (rf) systems has been limited by the non-differentiable nature of conventional rf simulators. the visibility of propagation paths causes severe discontinuities, and differentiable rendering techniques from computer graphics cannot easily transfer due to point-source antennas and dominant specular reflections. in this paper, we present rfdt, a 该论文涉及射频领域的数字孪生和可微渲染，与生物打印完全无关。 the paper is about rf digital twins and differentiable rendering, with no connection to bioprinting, biomedical applications, or ai integration into bioprinting workflows. 现有rf模拟器不可微，限制了数字孪生在射频系统中的应用。 提出基于物理的可微rf仿真框架rfdt，利用边缘衍射过渡函数和信号域变换。 能够从真实rf测量中准确重建数字孪生，并支持下游任务。 通过真实rf测量数据验证了框架的重建精度。 the non-differentiable nature of conventional rf simulators limits digital twin applications in radio frequency systems. rfdt, a physically accurate differentiable rf simulation framework, resolves discontinuities via an edge-diffraction transition function and mitigates non-convexity with a signal domain transform surrogate. rfdt accurately reconstructs digital twins from real rf measurements and enables downstream tasks such as test-time adaptation of ml-based rf sensing. the framework is validated using real rf measurement data to demonstrate reconstruction accuracy. radio frequency differentiable rendering digital twin electromagnetics inverse rendering differentiable rendering 可微渲染 digital twin 数字孪生 radio frequency 射频 edge diffraction 边缘衍射 signal domain transform 信号域变换 inverse rendering 逆渲染 electromagnetic simulation 电磁仿真 gradient-based optimization 基于梯度的优化 xingyu chen, xinyu zhang, kai zheng, xinmin fang, tzu-mao li arxiv preprint

authors: Jinger Chong, Xiaotong Zhang, Kamal Youcef-Toumi
blob: towards scalable probabilistic human motion prediction with gaussian processes for safe human-robot collaboration accurate human motion prediction with well-calibrated uncertainty is critical for safe human-robot collaboration (hrc), where robots must anticipate and react to human movements in real time. we propose a structured multitask variational gaussian process (gp) framework for full-body human motion prediction that captures temporal correlations and leverages joint-dimension-level factorization for scalability, while using a continuous 6d rotation representation to preserve kinematic consistency. ev jinger chong, xiaotong zhang, kamal youcef-toumi arxiv preprint

blob: building explicit world model for zero-shot open-world object manipulation open-world object manipulation remains a fundamental challenge in robotics. while vision-language-action (vla) models have demonstrated promising results, they rely heavily on large-scale robot action demonstrations, which are costly to collect and can hinder out-of-distribution generalization. in this paper, we propose an explicit-world-model-based framework for open-world manipulation that achieves zero-shot generalization by constructing a physically grounded digital twin of the environment.  该论文研究机器人操作中的数字孪生与零样本泛化，与生物打印ai方向无关。 this paper does not address bioprinting, bioink, cell printing, or any biomedical manufacturing context; it focuses on robotic manipulation and digital twins for general objects. 实现无需任务演示的开放世界物体操作零样本泛化。 构建物理数字孪生环境，结合开放集感知和仿真策略评估。 在多种开放操作任务上实现强零样本泛化，无需动作演示。 通过仿真和真实世界实验验证框架的泛化能力。 to achieve zero-shot generalization for open-world object manipulation without requiring task-specific robot demonstrations. proposes a framework that constructs a physically grounded digital twin of the environment, integrating open-set perception and physics-enabled simulation for strategy evaluation. the framework demonstrates strong zero-shot generalization across multiple open-set manipulation tasks at both task and object levels. validated through experiments in both simulation and real-world settings, showing successful task completion without prior demonstrations. open-world manipulation digital twin zero-shot generalization robotics vision-language-action model digital twin 数字孪生 zero-shot generalization 零样本泛化 open-world manipulation 开放世界操作 vision-language-action model 视觉-语言-动作模型 physically grounded 物理接地 xiaotong li, gang chen, javier alonso-mora arxiv preprint

authors: Vasiliy A. Es'kin, Egor V. Ivanov
blob: physics-informed neural systems for the simulation of euv electromagnetic wave diffraction from a lithography mask physics-informed neural networks (pinns) and neural operators (nos) for solving the problem of diffraction of extreme ultraviolet (euv) electromagnetic waves from contemporary lithography masks are presented. a novel hybrid waveguide neural operator (wgno) is introduced, based on a waveguide method with its most computationally expensive components replaced by a neural network. to evaluate performance, the accuracy and inference time of pinns and nos are compared against modern numerical solvers vasiliy a. es'kin, egor v. ivanov arxiv preprint

title: A scaled TW-PINN: A physics-informed neural network for traveling wave solutions of reaction-diffusion equations with general coefficients

blob: soft robotics and advanced technologies for minimally invasive bioprinting: the future of internal organ repair bioprinting, first proposed in the 1980s for ex vivo tissue fabrication, has evolved into a cornerstone of regenerative medicine. conventional approaches rely on printing tissues outside the body for later implantation but are limited by geometric mismatch, construct fragility, and invasive surgery. in situ bioprinting addresses these limitations by depositing cells and biomaterials directly at defect sites, enabling patient-specific repair and improved tissue integration. building on this parad 该综述讨论软体机器人和微创生物打印，提及ai作为未来方向但未嵌入具体流程。 this is a high-level review without ai integration into a specific bioprinting stage, no experimental validation, and no autonomous decision-making. 微创生物打印需要软体机器人技术以实现内部器官修复。 综述软体机器人、传感、成像、ai等在微创生物打印中的整合。 软体机器人是微创生物打印的关键硬件使能器。 无验证，仅为技术路线展望。 minimally invasive bioprinting requires soft robotic technologies to enable internal organ repair through small incisions. this review surveys soft actuation, sensing, real-time imaging, computational modeling, and ai integration for autonomous bioprinting. soft robotics is identified as the primary hardware enabler for navigating confined anatomical environments during in situ bioprinting. no experimental validation is performed; the paper presents a conceptual framework and future directions. review soft robotics minimally invasive bioprinting in situ bioprinting minimally invasive bioprinting 微创生物打印 soft robotics 软体机器人 in situ bioprinting 原位生物打印 bioink 生物墨水 artificial intelligence 人工智能 organ-on-a-chip 器官芯片 4d bioprinting 四维生物打印 d.t. vu, nhu an phan, sy trung ngo, minh tri phan, thanh‐an truong advanced science college of engineering & computer science vinuniversity  hanoi vietnam

title: Fractured Truths: A Collected Review of Modern Insights on Femoral Neck Fracture Management
authors: Jurek Rafal Tomasz Pietrzak, Dyllan Brett Geldenhuys, Caterina Nicolaou et al.
blob: fractured truths: a collected review of modern insights on femoral neck fracture management femoral neck fractures (fnfs) remain one of the most devastating injuries in adult patients, associated with a high morbidity, mortality and economic burden worldwide. the global incidence of hip fractures exceeds 1.6 million annually and is projected to rise to between 4.5 and 6.5 million by 2050. fnfs account for approximately 50% of all hip fractures and are strongly associated with aging, osteoporosis and frailty. mortality rates remain high, approaching 10% within the first month and up to  jurek rafal tomasz pietrzak, dyllan brett geldenhuys, caterina nicolaou, n elebo, nkhodiseni sikhauli orthopedic reviews university of the witwatersrand

title: Mechanobiological Implications of Low-Young's Modulus TiNbSn Alloy Plates for Fracture Fixation: A Focused Review.
authors: Yu Mori, Hidetatsu Tanaka, Masayuki Kamimura et al.
blob: mechanobiological implications of low-young's modulus tinbsn alloy plates for fracture fixation: a focused review. rigid internal fixation has long been the standard for fracture management; however, excessive construct stiffness can suppress interfragmentary strain, reduce callus formation, and impair secondary fracture healing. low-elastic-modulus tinbsn alloys have emerged as a promising alternative, offering mechanical behavior closer to that of cortical bone. this review synthesizes representative preclinical and computational evidence to clarify the mechanobiological rationale for tinbsn alloy plates i yu mori, hidetatsu tanaka, masayuki kamimura, naoko mori, toshimi aizawa medical sciences (basel, switzerland) department of orthopaedic surgery, tohoku university graduate school of medicine, sendai 980-8574, japan.

authors: Sanjay Chaudhuri, Dean Dustin, Bertrand Clarke
blob: uncertainty quantification via the posterior predictive variance we use the law of total variance to generate multiple expansions for the posterior predictive variance. these expansions are sums of terms involving conditional expectations and conditional variances and provide a quantification of the sources of predictive uncertainty. since the posterior predictive variance is fixed given the model, it represents a constant quantity that is conserved over these expansions. the terms in the expansions can be assessed in absolute or relative sense to understand  该论文提供了一种通用的后验预测方差分解方法，可用于替代模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。 the paper does not address fea surrogate modeling, expensive simulation sampling, constraint handling, or application to implant/biomechanics design. 量化预测不确定性来源，改进模型评估。 利用全方差公式展开后验预测方差。 识别预测区间长度的主要贡献项及其守恒性。 在若干经典模型上理论验证。 to decompose the posterior predictive variance into interpretable components for assessing predictive uncertainty sources. multiple expansions of the posterior predictive variance are derived using the law of total variance, with terms involving conditional expectations and variances. the expansions reveal that the total variance is conserved, and small or zero terms in one expansion force corresponding terms in other expansions to be small or zero. the approach is demonstrated on several well-known statistical models through theoretical analysis and numerical examples. uncertainty quantification posterior predictive variance law of total variance predictive model assessment uncertainty quantification 不确定性量化 posterior predictive variance 后验预测方差 law of total variance 全方差公式 predictive model assessment 预测模型评估 conditional expectation 条件期望 sanjay chaudhuri, dean dustin, bertrand clarke arxiv preprint

blob: a lattice boltzmann thermal model for predicting melt pool geometry in selective laser melting of alsi10mg and 316l stainless steel selective laser melting (slm) is a complex additive manufacturing process involving rapid laser-material interaction, steep thermal gradients, and phase change phenomena. in this work, a two-dimensional thermal model based on the lattice boltzmann method (lbm) is developed to simulate the slm process of alsi10mg and 316l stainless steel (316l ss) alloys. the model captures the laser-material interaction, layer-by-layer deposition, phase change behavior, and heat transfer mechanisms, including co rigoberto guzmán-nogales, luis a. reyes-osorio, guadalupe maribel hernández-muñoz, alex elı́as-zúñiga, omar eduardo lopez-botello materials centro de innovación e investigación en ingeniería aeronáutica, facultad de ingeniería mecánica y eléctrica, universidad autónoma de nuevo león, san nicolás de los garza 66455, n.l., mexico

blob: conformal prediction for nonparametric instrumental regression we propose a method for constructing distribution-free prediction intervals in nonparametric instrumental variable regression (npiv), with finite-sample coverage guarantees. building on the conditional guarantee framework in conformal inference, we reformulate conditional coverage as marginal coverage over a class of iv shifts $\mathcal{f}$. our method can be combined with any npiv estimator, including sieve 2sls and other machine-learning-based npiv methods such as neural networks minimax appro masahiro kato arxiv preprint

blob: optimer: optimal distribution vector merging is better than data mixing for continual pre-training continual pre-training is widely used to adapt llms to target languages and domains, yet the mixture ratio of training data remains a sensitive hyperparameter that is expensive to tune: they must be fixed before training begins, and a suboptimal choice can waste weeks of compute. in this work, we propose optimer, which decouples ratio selection from training: we train one cpt model per dataset, extract each model's distribution vector, which represents the parameter shift induced by that dataset 该论文讨论的是大型语言模型的持续预训练，与fea替代模型和植入物生物力学完全无关。 this paper addresses continual pre-training for llms with distribution merging; it contains no fea, surrogate modeling, optimization for expensive simulations, uncertainty quantification, or any biomechanics context. 传统数据混合比例选择昂贵且不可逆，需要更灵活的方法。 分别训练每个数据集模型，提取分布向量，通过贝叶斯优化后验合并权重。 optimer以15-35倍更低搜索成本优于数据混合和模型平均基线。 在gemma 3 27b上对日语、中文、数学、代码任务进行实验验证。 continual pre-training data mixture ratio selection is expensive and fixed beforehand; a post-hoc paradigm can reduce cost and increase flexibility. train separate models per dataset, extract distribution vectors representing parameter shifts, and optimize merging weights via bayesian optimization post-training. optimer consistently outperforms data mixing and model averaging baselines with 15-35 times lower search cost on language and domain tasks. empirical validation on gemma 3 27b across japanese, chinese, math, and code domains. llm continual pre-training data mixture distribution vector continual pre-training 持续预训练 distribution vector 分布向量 bayesian optimization 贝叶斯优化 data mixture 数据混合 model averaging 模型平均 haiyue song, masao utiyama arxiv preprint

title: LDDMM stochastic interpolants: an application to domain uncertainty quantification in hemodynamics
authors: Sarah Katz, Francesco Romor, Jia-Jie Zhu et al.
blob: lddmm stochastic interpolants: an application to domain uncertainty quantification in hemodynamics we introduce a novel conditional stochastic interpolant framework for generative modeling of three-dimensional shapes. the method builds on a recent lddmm-based registration approach to learn the conditional drift between geometries. by leveraging the resulting pull-back and push-forward operators, we extend this formulation beyond standard cartesian grids to complex shapes and random variables defined on distinct domains. we present an application in the context of cardiovascular simulations, w sarah katz, francesco romor, jia-jie zhu, alfonso caiazzo arxiv preprint

title: An Isotropic Approach to Efficient Uncertainty Quantification with Gradient Norms
authors: Nils Grünefeld, Jes Frellsen, Christian Hardmeier
blob: an isotropic approach to efficient uncertainty quantification with gradient norms existing methods for quantifying predictive uncertainty in neural networks are either computationally intractable for large language models or require access to training data that is typically unavailable. we derive a lightweight alternative through two approximations: a first-order taylor expansion that expresses uncertainty in terms of the gradient of the prediction and the parameter covariance, and an isotropy assumption on the parameter covariance. together, these yield epistemic uncertainty nils grünefeld, jes frellsen, christian hardmeier arxiv preprint

blob: a unified weighted-loss physics-informed neural network for boundary layer problems in singularly perturbed pdes singularly perturbed partial differential equations arise in many applications, including magnetohydrodynamic duct flows, chemical reaction transport systems, and poisson boltzmann electrostatics. these problems are characterized by sharp boundary layers and pronounced multiscale behavior, posing significant challenges for numerical methods. existing approaches, particularly machine learning based methods, often rely on explicit asymptotic decompositions or specialized architectures, increasing  该论文提出的加权损失pinn方法可处理奇异扰动pde中的边界层问题，对于生物力学有限元代理模型中的多尺度挑战具有潜在借鉴意义。 the paper does not address sampling efficiency, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or direct application to implant/biomechanics design. 现有pinn处理奇异扰动pde边界层时优化失衡，需简化流程。 提出统一加权损失pinn框架，仅需边界层厚度先验，自动识别边界层位置。 在标量和耦合反应扩散/对流扩散系统中实现高达10^{-10}边界层厚度的鲁棒解。 通过规则及不规则域上的数值实验验证算法性能。 existing pinn methods suffer from optimization imbalance in stiff regimes when solving singularly perturbed pdes with sharp boundary layers. this work introduces a unified weighted-loss pinn framework that requires only prior knowledge of boundary layer thickness and automatically identifies layer locations during training. the method demonstrates robust performance and high accuracy for boundary layers as thin as 10^{-10} across scalar and coupled reaction-diffusion and convection-diffusion-reaction systems on regular and irregular domains. the approach is validated through extensive numerical benchmarks on multiple equation types and domain geometries. pinn weighted loss boundary layer singular perturbation surrogate modeling physics-informed neural network 物理信息神经网络 singular perturbation 奇异摄动 boundary layer 边界层 weighted loss 加权损失 multiscale behavior 多尺度行为 wei-fan hu, shi-xiang zhong, po-wen hsieh, chung-kai chen, te-sheng lin arxiv preprint

blob: the mark coventry award: five-year outcomes of a randomized controlled trial on cemented versus uncemented total knee arthroplasty: the kneefix trial. background: uncemented total knee arthroplasty (tka) components were developed to improve fixation relative to cemented implants. while uncemented femoral components have yielded favorable results, outcomes for earlier uncemented tibial and patellar designs have been inconsistent. contemporary trabecular-metal implants aim to enhance biological fixation by optimizing osseointegration, yet randomized data comparing fully uncemented constructs, including the patella, are limited. we conducted a pr 该论文为全膝关节置换术的临床随机对照试验，未涉及增材制造或生物力学分析。 no additive manufacturing, no mechanical testing, no porous structure design, no stress shielding analysis. 比较全膝关节置换术中骨水泥型与非骨水泥型假体的五年临床结果 前瞻性单盲随机对照试验，316例膝关节随机分为骨水泥组和非骨水泥组 非骨水泥组非进展性透亮线更少，但两组在翻修率和患者报告结果上无差异 五年临床随访，97%随访率，影像学及患者报告结果评估 to compare five-year clinical and radiological outcomes of cemented versus uncemented total knee arthroplasty with trabecular metal implants. a prospective, single-blind rct with 316 knees randomized to fully cemented or fully uncemented tka, assessing fixation and patient-reported outcomes. uncemented tka had fewer nonprogressive radiolucent lines but equivalent revision rates and clinical scores at five years. clinical validation with 97% follow-up at five years, using standardized radiographs and validated patient-reported outcome measures. total knee arthroplasty cemented vs uncemented clinical outcomes total knee arthroplasty 全膝关节置换术 uncemented 非骨水泥型 cemented 骨水泥型 trabecular metal 骨小梁金属 radiolucent lines 透亮线 osseointegration 骨整合 randomized controlled trial 随机对照试验 simon w young, mei lin tay, kohei kawaguchi, william j farrington, rupert van rooyen the journal of arthroplasty department of orthopaedic surgery, north shore hospital, auckland, new zealand; department of surgery, university of auckland, auckland, new zealand.

title: Variational Quantum Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Hydrological PDE-Constrained Learning with Inherent Uncertainty Quantification
authors: Prasad Nimantha Madusanka Ukwatta Hewage, Midhun Chakkravarthy, Ruvan Kumara Abeysekara
blob: variational quantum physics-informed neural networks for hydrological pde-constrained learning with inherent uncertainty quantification we propose a hybrid quantum-classical physics-informed neural network (hqc-pinn) that integrates parameterized variational quantum circuits into the pinn framework for hydrological pde-constrained learning. our architecture encodes multi-source remote sensing features into quantum states via trainable angle encoding, processes them through a hardware-efficient variational ansatz with entangling layers, and constrains the output using the saint-venant shallow water equations and manning's flow eq prasad nimantha madusanka ukwatta hewage, midhun chakkravarthy, ruvan kumara abeysekara arxiv preprint

title: A reduced-order model for parametrized Optimal Transport problems
authors: Elise Bonnet-Weill, Virginie Ehrlacher, Luca Nenna

title: Meta-Learned Basis Adaptation for Parametric Linear PDEs
authors: Vikas Dwivedi, Monica Sigovan, Bruno Sixou
blob: meta-learned basis adaptation for parametric linear pdes we propose a hybrid physics-informed framework for solving families of parametric linear partial differential equations (pdes) by combining a meta-learned predictor with a least-squares corrector. the predictor, termed \textbf{kapi} (kernel-adaptive physics-informed meta-learner), is a shallow task-conditioned model that maps query coordinates and pde parameters to solution values while internally generating an interpretable, task-adaptive gaussian basis geometry. a lightweight meta-network maps vikas dwivedi, monica sigovan, bruno sixou arxiv preprint

title: Uncertainty-Aware Transformers: Conformal Prediction for Language Models
authors: Abhiram Vellore, Niraj K. Jha
blob: uncertainty-aware transformers: conformal prediction for language models transformers have had a profound impact on the field of artificial intelligence, especially on large language models and their variants. however, as was the case with neural networks, their black-box nature limits trust and deployment in high-stakes settings. for models to be genuinely useful and trustworthy in critical applications, they must provide more than just predictions: they must supply users with a clear understanding of the reasoning that underpins their decisions. this article presen 该论文关注语言模型的量化不确定性，与有限元替代模型或生物力学设计完全无关。 this paper does not address any aspect of fea surrogate modeling, expensive simulation sampling, constraint handling, or biomechanics/implant design; it is purely about uncertainty quantification for nlp models. 在关键应用中需要可信赖的语言模型预测和不确定性估计。 提出confide框架，在微调语言模型内部嵌入上应用共形预测。 bert-tiny测试准确率提升达4.09%，预测集效率优于现有方法。 在多个nlp基准数据集上实验验证。 to enable trustworthy deployment of transformer-based language models in high-stakes applications by providing statistically valid uncertainty estimates. confide applies conformal prediction to internal embeddings of encoder-only transformers (e.g., bert, roberta) using [cls] token or flattened hidden states to construct class-conditional nonconformity scores. confide improves test accuracy by up to 4.09% on bert-tiny and achieves better correct efficiency than prior conformal baselines. empirical evaluation on multiple nlp benchmark datasets with comparisons to nm2 and vanillann. conformal prediction transformers language models uncertainty quantification deep learning conformal prediction 共形预测 transformer transformer uncertainty quantification 不确定性量化 nonconformity score 非一致性得分 prediction set 预测集 abhiram vellore, niraj k. jha arxiv preprint

title: Auxiliary Finite-Difference Residual-Gradient Regularization for PINNs
authors: Stavros Kassinos
blob: auxiliary finite-difference residual-gradient regularization for pinns physics-informed neural networks (pinns) are often selected by a single scalar loss even when the quantity of interest is more specific. we study a hybrid design in which the governing pde residual remains automatic-differentiation (ad) based, while finite differences (fd) appear only in a weak auxiliary term that penalizes gradients of the sampled residual field. the fd term regularizes the residual field without replacing the pde residual itself.   we examine this idea in two stages. stage 1 i stavros kassinos arxiv preprint

title: UI-Zoomer: Uncertainty-Driven Adaptive Zoom-In for GUI Grounding
authors: Fei Tang, Bofan Chen, Zhengxi Lu et al.
blob: ui-zoomer: uncertainty-driven adaptive zoom-in for gui grounding gui grounding, which localizes interface elements from screenshots given natural language queries, remains challenging for small icons and dense layouts. test-time zoom-in methods improve localization by cropping and re-running inference at higher resolution, but apply cropping uniformly across all instances with fixed crop sizes, ignoring whether the model is actually uncertain on each case. we propose \textbf{ui-zoomer}, a training-free adaptive zoom-in framework that treats both the trigger a 该论文涉及gui视觉定位中的自适应缩放方法，与计算力学、有限元代理建模或植入物设计完全无关。 this paper addresses gui grounding in computer vision, with no connection to finite element analysis, surrogate modeling, uncertainty quantification for physical simulations, or biomechanical implant design. 解决gui小图标和密集布局定位困难的问题 提出不确定性驱动的自适应缩放框架，包括置信度感知门和不确定性驱动的裁剪尺寸模块 在多个基准测试上提升了定位精度，无需额外训练 在screenspot-pro等数据集上对比基线模型 small icons and dense layouts pose challenges for gui grounding, and existing test-time zoom-in methods apply uniform cropping without considering model uncertainty. ui-zoomer uses a confidence-aware gate to selectively trigger zoom-in based on uncertainty, and an uncertainty-driven crop sizing module that leverages total variance decomposition to adapt crop radius per instance. the method achieves up to +13.4% improvement on screenspot-pro, +10.3% on ui-vision, and +4.2% on screenspot-v2, consistently outperforming baselines without additional training. evaluated on three public datasets (screenspot-pro, ui-vision, screenspot-v2) across multiple model architectures. gui grounding uncertainty quantification adaptive zoom-in computer vision gui grounding gui视觉定位 uncertainty quantification 不确定性量化 adaptive zoom-in 自适应缩放 confidence-aware gate 置信度感知门 crop sizing 裁剪尺寸 law of total variance 总方差定律 fei tang, bofan chen, zhengxi lu, tongbo chen, songqin nong arxiv preprint

title: Diagnosing LLM Judge Reliability: Conformal Prediction Sets and Transitivity Violations
authors: Manan Gupta, Dhruv Kumar
blob: diagnosing llm judge reliability: conformal prediction sets and transitivity violations llm-as-judge frameworks are increasingly used for automatic nlg evaluation, yet their per-instance reliability remains poorly understood. we present a two-pronged diagnostic toolkit applied to summeval: $\textbf{(1)}$ a transitivity analysis that reveals widespread per-input inconsistency masked by low aggregate violation rates ($\barρ = 0.8$-$4.1\%$), with $33$-$67\%$ of documents exhibiting at least one directed 3-cycle; and $\textbf{(2)}$ split conformal prediction sets over 1-5 likert scores manan gupta, dhruv kumar arxiv preprint

blob: chronax: a jax library for univariate statistical forecasting and conformal inference time-series forecasting is central to many scientific and industrial domains, such as energy systems, climate modeling, finance, and retail. while forecasting methods have evolved from classical statistical models to automated, and neural approaches, the surrounding software ecosystem remains anchored to the traditional python numerical stack. existing libraries rely on interpreter-driven execution and object-oriented abstractions, limiting composability, large-scale parallelism, and integration 该论文是关于时间序列预测的软件库，与有限元代理建模或生物力学设计无关。 this paper does not address expensive simulation sampling, surrogate modeling, constraints, or uncertainty quantification for fea or implant/biomechanics design. 解决传统时间序列库在可扩展性和加速器兼容性上的局限 基于jax构建纯函数式时间序列预测库，支持编译和自动向量化 实现可扩展的多序列预测与模型无关的保形不确定性量化 未涉及实验验证，仅展示框架设计 traditional time-series forecasting libraries are limited by interpreter-driven execution and lack of integration with modern accelerator-oriented workflows. chronax is a jax-native library that uses pure functions and program transformations for scalable multi-series forecasting and conformal uncertainty quantification. the library enables efficient execution on cpus, gpus, and tpus, and supports model-agnostic uncertainty estimates. no experimental validation is provided; the paper focuses on library design and capabilities. time-series forecasting jax conformal inference time-series forecasting 时间序列预测 jax jax conformal inference 保形推断 uncertainty quantification 不确定性量化 functional programming 函数式编程 xan carey, yash deshmukh, aileen huang, sunit jadhav, omkar tekawade arxiv preprint

title: Rewind-IL: Online Failure Detection and State Respawning for Imitation Learning
authors: Gehan Zheng, Sanjay Seenivasan, Matthew Johnson-Roberson et al.

title: FLARE: A Data-Efficient Surrogate for Predicting Displacement Fields in Directed Energy Deposition
authors: Kittipong Thiamchaiboonthawee, Ghadi Nehme, Ram Mohan Telikicherla et al.
blob: flare: a data-efficient surrogate for predicting displacement fields in directed energy deposition directed energy deposition (ded) produces complex thermo-mechanical responses that can lead to distortion and reduced dimensional accuracy of a manufactured part. thermo-mechanical finite element simulations are widely used to estimate these effects, but their computational cost and the complexity of accurately capturing ded physics limit their use in design iteration and process optimization. this paper introduces flare (field prediction via linear affine reconstruction in weight-space), a data 该方法在数据效率和外推方面有优势，可迁移到生物力学代理模型，但未涉及约束、uq或植入物设计。 the paper focuses on ded displacement prediction without handling constraints, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanics/implant context. ded工艺有限元模拟成本高，限制设计迭代。 提出flare框架，用隐式神经场编码位移场并利用仿射混合预测新参数。 在ded基准上比基线方法更准确，支持内外推。 基于开源fem生成数据集进行数值验证。 thermo-mechanical simulations in ded are computationally expensive, hindering design iteration and process optimization. flare encodes simulation fields via implicit neural networks and predicts for unseen parameters by affine mixing of training weights. the method achieves superior accuracy on ded displacement predictions for both in-distribution and extrapolation tasks. validated on a numerical benchmark dataset generated from an open-source finite element ded simulation workflow. neural field surrogate modeling ded affine reconstruction data-efficient implicit neural field 隐式神经场 surrogate modeling 代理建模 directed energy deposition 定向能量沉积 affine reconstruction 仿射重建 data-efficient 数据高效 displacement field 位移场 thermo-mechanical simulation 热力模拟 kittipong thiamchaiboonthawee, ghadi nehme, ram mohan telikicherla, jiawei tian, balaji jayaraman arxiv preprint

title: Factor Graph-Based Shape Estimation for Continuum Robots via Magnus Expansion
authors: Lorenzo Ticozzi, Patricio A. Vela, Panagiotis Tsiotras
blob: factor graph-based shape estimation for continuum robots via magnus expansion reconstructing the shape of continuum manipulators from sparse, noisy sensor data is a challenging task, owing to the infinite-dimensional nature of such systems. existing approaches broadly trade off between parametric methods that yield compact state representations but lack probabilistic structure, and cosserat rod inference on factor graphs, which provides principled uncertainty quantification at the cost of a state dimension that grows with the spatial discretization. this letter combines t 该论文涉及连续机器人的形状估计，与有限元代理模型或植入物设计无关。 no fea simulation, no surrogate modeling, no uncertainty quantification for design, and no implant/biomechanics context. 从稀疏噪声传感器数据中重构连续机械臂形状 结合gvs参数化和因子图框架，利用magnus展开推导封闭形式运动学因子 仿真中平均位置误差低于2mm，姿态误差比高斯过程回归降低六倍 在仿真中测试三种测量配置下的形状估计精度 reconstructing the shape of continuum manipulators from sparse, noisy sensor data remains challenging due to their infinite-dimensional nature. we combine a low-dimensional geometric variable strain parameterization with factor graph inference, deriving a novel kinematic factor via magnus expansion to encode rod geometry. the proposed method achieves mean position errors below 2 mm in simulation and a sixfold reduction in orientation error compared to a gaussian process regression baseline. validation is performed through simulation experiments on a 0.4 m long tendon-driven continuum robot under three different measurement configurations. continuum robot shape estimation factor graph magnus expansion geometric variable strain continuum robot 连续型机器人 shape estimation 形状估计 factor graph 因子图 magnus expansion magnus展开 geometric variable strain 几何变量应变 cosserat rod cosserat杆 lorenzo ticozzi, patricio a. vela, panagiotis tsiotras arxiv preprint

title: Calibrating conditional risk
authors: Andrey Vasilyev, Yikai Wang, Xiaocheng Li et al.
blob: calibrating conditional risk we introduce and study the problem of calibrating conditional risk, which involves estimating the expected loss of a prediction model conditional on input features. we analyze this problem in both classification and regression settings and show that it is fundamentally equivalent to a standard regression task. for classification settings, we further establish a connection between conditional risk calibration and individual/conditional probability calibration, and develop theoretical insights for andrey vasilyev, yikai wang, xiaocheng li, guanting chen arxiv preprint

blob: rethinking trust region bayesian optimization in high dimensions trust region bayesian optimization (turbo) is an effective strategy for alleviating the curse of dimensionality in high-dimensional black-box optimization. however, inappropriate lengthscale design can cause the local gaussian process (gp) model within the trust region to degenerate, leading to suboptimal performance in high dimensions. in this work, we show that turbo's local gp may remain either excessively complex or overly simple as the dimension $d$ and trust region side length $l$ vary. to wei-ting tang, joel a. paulson arxiv preprint

it focuses on a piezoelectric coating for osseointegration in osteoporosis. 改善骨质疏松条件下钛植入体的骨整合效果。 在钛表面构建batio3纳米棒/ha纳米颗粒压电阵列，结合lipus增强压电势。 压电阵列通过钙离子内流促进atp合成，恢复线粒体质量控制，增强骨整合。 通过仿真验证压电势增强机制，细胞实验验证线粒体功能。 to improve osseointegration of titanium implants under osteoporotic conditions by mitigating mitochondrial oxidative stress. a piezo-metastructured array of batio3 nanorods decorated with ha nanoparticles was fabricated on ti, and low-intensity pulsed ultrasound was applied to enhance piezoelectric potential. the enhanced piezoelectric potential activated calcium channels, elevated mitochondrial calcium, promoted atp synthesis, and restored mitochondrial quality control, leading to improved osseointegration. simulation confirmed the piezoelectric enhancement mechanism, and in vitro cell experiments demonstrated mitochondrial function restoration. piezoelectric osseointegration osteoporosis titanium implant mitochondrial quality control piezoelectric potential 压电势 osseointegration 骨整合 osteoporosis 骨质疏松 mitochondrial quality control 线粒体质量控制 low-intensity pulsed ultrasound 低强度脉冲超声 titanium implant 钛植入体 batio3 nanorods 钛酸钡纳米棒 hydroxyapatite 羟基磷灰石 shifeng peng, kai wang, xiaona ning, bo li, minggang zhang biomaterials

blob: what's new in osteogenesis imperfecta. unlabelled: osteogenesis imperfecta (oi) is a diverse group of genetic disorders mainly caused by pathogenic variants in col1a1 and col1a2 that interfere with type i collagen production, resulting in bone fragility and multisystem issues. since 2019, the understanding and treatment of oi have improved considerably. advances in molecular genetics have broadened the oi classification to 22 types, with new variants affecting pathways beyond collagen synthesis, including osteoblast differentiation a maegen wallace, bryan menapace, christina herrero, jeanne m franzone journal of the pediatric orthopaedic society of north america phoenix children's hospital, phoenix, az, usa.

blob: neural-schwarz tiling for geometry-universal pde solving at scale most learned pde solvers follow a global-surrogate paradigm: a neural operator is trained to map full problem descriptions to full solution fields for a prescribed distribution of geometries, boundary conditions, and coefficients. this has enabled fast inference within fixed problem families, but limits reuse across new domains and makes large-scale deployment dependent on expensive problem-specific data generation. we introduce $\textbf{nest}$ ($\textbf{ne}$ural-$\textbf{s}$chwarz $\textbf{t}$i 该论文提出的局部到全局的神经求解器框架可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，提高大规模复杂几何域上的求解效率。 the paper does not address implant-specific mechanics, stress shielding, or biomedical constraints, and lacks experimental validation in a biomechanical context. 现有全局神经求解器难以泛化到新几何域，需大量数据生成。 提出nest框架，学习局部物理求解器并通过schwarz迭代组合成全局解。 在非线性超弹性固体问题上，方法能泛化到远大于训练域尺寸的复杂3d几何。 通过数值模拟验证局部-全局组合求解的精度和泛化能力。 global neural pde solvers suffer from poor generalization to unseen geometries and require expensive problem-specific data generation. nest learns a local neural operator on minimal voxel patches and assembles global solutions via schwarz domain decomposition with partition-of-unity. the method generalizes to large, geometrically complex 3d domains far beyond training patch scale for nonlinear neo-hookean elasticity. numerical simulation cases on static equilibrium of compressible neo-hookean solids demonstrate accuracy and scalability. neural operator domain decomposition pde solving finite element surrogate geometry generalization neural operator 神经算子 domain decomposition 区域分解 schwarz iteration schwarz迭代 local-to-global 局部到全局 pde solving 偏微分方程求解 geometry generalization 几何泛化 voxel patch 体素块 neo-hookean solid neo-hookean固体 paolo secchi, daniel s. balint, marco maurizi arxiv preprint

title: Multi-Variable Conformal Prediction: Optimizing Prediction Sets without Data Splitting
authors: Laura Lützow, Simone Garatti, Marco C. Campi et al.
blob: multi-variable conformal prediction: optimizing prediction sets without data splitting conformal prediction constructs prediction sets with finite-sample coverage guarantees, but its calibration stage is structurally constrained to a scalar score function and a single threshold variable - forcing shapes of prediction sets to be fixed before calibration, typically through data splitting. we introduce multi-variable conformal prediction (mcp), a framework that extends conformal prediction to vector-valued score functions with multiple simultaneous calibration variables. building on  该论文提出了一种无需数据分割的多变量共形预测方法，可应用于代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及fea或生物力学设计。 this paper does not address fea surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical design context; it focuses purely on conformal prediction methodology. 现有共形预测需数据分割且预测集形状固定，效率低。 提出多变量共形预测框架，将预测集设计与校准统一为优化问题。 无需数据分割即可达到目标覆盖率，且预测集更小、方差更低。 在椭球和多模态预测集上数值验证。 standard conformal prediction requires data splitting and fixes prediction set shapes before calibration, limiting efficiency. we propose multi-variable conformal prediction (mcp) that unifies prediction set design and calibration into a single optimization problem using scenario theory. mcp achieves target coverage without data splitting, with smaller or comparable prediction set sizes and reduced variance across calibration runs. numerical experiments on ellipsoidal and multi-modal prediction sets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed methods. conformal prediction uncertainty quantification scenario theory optimization conformal prediction 共形预测 uncertainty quantification 不确定性量化 scenario theory 场景理论 data splitting 数据分割 prediction set 预测集 laura lützow, simone garatti, marco c. campi, lars lindemann, matthias althoff arxiv preprint

title: VNDUQE: Information-Theoretic Novelty Detection using Deep Variational Information Bottleneck

blob: vnduqe: information-theoretic novelty detection using deep variational information bottleneck detecting out-of-distribution (ood) samples is critical for safe deployment of neural networks in safety-critical applications. while maximum softmax probability (msp) provides a simple baseline, it lacks theoretical grounding and suffers from miscalibration. we propose vnduqe (vib-based novelty detection and uncertainty quantification for nondestructive evaluation), which investigates novelty detection through the deep variational information bottleneck (vib), which explicitly constrains inform 该论文研究基于信息瓶颈的ood检测，与fea代理模型或生物力学设计无直接关联。 this paper does not address expensive simulation sampling, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on image-based ood detection with no fea or surrogate modeling context. 安全关键应用中神经网络ood检测需要理论支撑和校准。 使用深度变分信息瓶颈约束表示学习，结合kl散度和预测熵进行ood检测。 kl散度在远ood上达100% auroc，预测熵在近ood上达94.7% auroc。 在mnist留出类、噪声和域偏移上评估auroc和校准误差。 safe deployment of neural networks requires theoretically grounded and well-calibrated out-of-distribution detection. the deep variational information bottleneck is employed to constrain representation learning, and kl divergence and prediction entropy are used as complementary ood detection metrics. kl divergence achieves perfect far-ood detection (100% auroc on noise), while prediction entropy excels at near-ood detection (94.7% auroc on novel digits), with a combined strategy improving auroc by 32 percentage points over msp. validation is performed on mnist with held-out classes, noise, and domain shift, evaluating auroc and expected calibration error. novelty detection variational information bottleneck uncertainty quantification ood detection mnist out-of-distribution detection 分布外检测 variational information bottleneck 变分信息瓶颈 uncertainty quantification 不确定性量化 kl divergence kl散度 prediction entropy 预测熵 expected calibration error 期望校准误差 aryan gondkar, hayder radha, yiming deng arxiv preprint

blob: prospects for the use of 3d bioprinting and tissue engineering technologies in clinical otorhinolaryngology (literature review) the article provides an overview of data on the prevalence, conservative, and surgical treatment of chronic suppurative otitis media, which remains one of the most common and socially significant diseases of the otorhinolaryngological structures, accompanied by a high frequency of complications and persistent hearing loss. the evolution of treatment methods is traced, and special attention is given to the prospects for the use of tissue engineering constructs and tissue engineering in general. t 该论文仅综述了3d生物打印在耳鼻喉科的应用前景，未涉及ai集成或实验验证。 this paper is a literature review on tissue engineering for otorhinolaryngology, with no ai integration, no experimental validation of bioprinting, and no autonomous decision-making. 综述3d生物打印在耳鼻喉科修复鼓膜缺损的应用前景 文献综述，分析传统与创新鼓室成形术方法 组织工程移植物和生长因子可提高穿孔闭合成功率 无实验验证，仅引用临床和实验研究结果 this review explores the potential of 3d bioprinting and tissue engineering to improve outcomes in chronic suppurative otitis media treatment. a literature review comparing classical tympanoplasty methods with innovative tissue engineering approaches, including 3d bioprinting and cellular therapies. tissue-engineered constructs and growth factors significantly increase the success rate of eardrum perforation closure compared to traditional autografts. no original validation; the review summarizes clinical and experimental studies from the literature. 3d bioprinting tissue engineering otorhinolaryngology literature review tympanoplasty 3d bioprinting 3d生物打印 tissue engineering 组织工程 tympanoplasty 鼓室成形术 eardrum perforation 鼓膜穿孔 mesenchymal stem cells 间充质干细胞 growth factors 生长因子 autograft 自体移植物 collagen matrix 胶原基质 a.i. kryukov, e o osidak, sp domogatsky, e. v. garov, v.n. zelenkova russian bulletin of otorhinolaryngology

blob: topology-preserving neural operator learning via hodge decomposition in this paper, we study solution operators of physical field equations on geometric meshes from a function-space perspective. we reveal that hodge orthogonality fundamentally resolves spectral interference by isolating unlearnable topological degrees of freedom from learnable geometric dynamics, enabling an additive approximation confined to structure-preserving subspaces. building on hodge theory and operator splitting, we derive a principled operator-level decomposition. the result is a hybrid 该论文提出了一种基于hodge分解的拓扑保持神经算子，可提升物理场求解的精度和效率，对fea代理建模具有潜在迁移价值。 this paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant mechanics problems, lacks experimental validation, and does not address uncertainty quantification or multi-objective constraints. 解决几何网格上物理场求解中谱干扰和拓扑自由度不可学习的问题 利用hodge正交性和算子分裂，提出混合欧拉-拉格朗日架构及hodge谱对偶归纳偏置 在几何图上实现了更高的精度和效率，并增强了对物理不变量的保真度 在数值基准测试上验证了方法的准确性和效率 to address spectral interference and unlearnable topological degrees of freedom in learning solution operators on geometric meshes. a hybrid eulerian-lagrangian architecture with hodge spectral duality inductive bias is derived via hodge orthogonality and operator splitting. the method achieves superior accuracy and efficiency on geometric graphs with enhanced fidelity to physical invariants. validation is performed on numerical benchmarks demonstrating accuracy and efficiency. neural operator hodge decomposition topology preservation geometric meshes physical invariants neural operator 神经算子 hodge decomposition hodge分解 topology preservation 拓扑保持 geometric mesh 几何网格 physical invariants 物理不变量 operator splitting 算子分裂 discrete differential forms 离散微分形式 inductive bias 归纳偏置 dongzhe zheng, tao zhong, christine allen-blanchette arxiv preprint

authors: Gordan Prastalo, Kevin Maik Jablonka
blob: reducing cross-sample prediction churn in scientific machine learning scientific machine learning reports predictive performance. it does not report whether the same prediction would survive a different draw of training data. across $9$ chemistry benchmarks, two classifiers trained on independent bootstraps of the same training set agree on aggregate accuracy to within $1.3\text{--}4.2$ percentage points but disagree on the class label of $8.0\text{--}21.8\%$ of test molecules. we call this gap \emph{cross-sample prediction churn}. the standard parameter-side tech 该论文关注科学机器学习中的预测一致性，而非fea代理建模或生物力学设计优化。 this paper does not address expensive simulation sampling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification for point predictions, or transferability to implant/biomechanics design. 科学机器学习报告预测性能，但未报告不同训练数据下预测的一致性。 提出交叉样本预测波动概念，并采用k-bootstrap装袋和双bootstrap方法降低波动。 k-bootstrap装袋降低波动40-54%，双bootstrap进一步降低45%。 在9个化学基准数据集上验证，比较聚合准确率与标签不一致率。 scientific machine learning typically reports predictive performance but ignores whether predictions are consistent across different training data draws. the paper introduces cross-sample prediction churn and proposes k-bootstrap bagging and twin-bootstrap (joint training with sym-kl consistency loss) to reduce it. k-bootstrap bagging reduces churn by 40-54% with no accuracy loss, and twin-bootstrap further reduces it by a median 45% beyond bagging-k=2. validated on nine chemistry benchmarks by comparing aggregate accuracy and per-molecule label disagreement between classifiers trained on independent bootstraps. prediction churn scientific machine learning ensemble methods bootstrap chemistry benchmarks prediction churn 预测波动 scientific machine learning 科学机器学习 bootstrap 自助法 bagging 装袋 ensemble 集成 consistency loss 一致性损失 chemistry benchmark 化学基准 gordan prastalo, kevin maik jablonka arxiv preprint

blob: what's in a nam? the transition away from animal experimentation is gaining momentum across scientific disciplines, driven by technological advancements, ethical imperatives and policy support. at the forefront of this movement is the development of new approach methodologies (nams). rather than serving as mere substitutes for animal testing, nams represent a paradigm shift. their growing acceptance has been reinforced by recent policy advancements, such as the us food and drug administration modernization act 2 该论文主要讨论替代动物实验的新方法论(nams)，仅提及3d生物打印和ai作为技术工具，未深入ai与生物打印的具体结合。 this paper is a policy/definition review of nams, not an ai-bioprinting method; it lacks any ai integration into a bioprinting workflow stage and has no experimental validation. 动物实验替代方法(nams)定义模糊，需统一。 提出nams定义：不包括活体动物的物种特异性方法。 nams与3rs框架不同，强调目标物种直接使用。 无实验验证，为概念性讨论。 the term 'new approach methodologies' (nams) has become ambiguous, necessitating a unified definition to avoid confusion and misuse. a definition is proposed: nams are species-specific methodologies that exclude the use of living animals, prioritizing target species data. nams represent a paradigm shift from the 3rs framework, leveraging technologies like organoids, bioprinting, and ai for human-relevant research. no experimental validation; the paper is a conceptual and policy discussion. nams 3d bioprinting ai policy review new approach methodologies (nams) 新方法论(nams) 3rs framework 3rs框架 3d bioprinting 3d生物打印 artificial intelligence 人工智能 organ-on-chip 器官芯片 species-specific 物种特异性 animal-free regulatory system 无动物监管体系 arti ahluwalia, babette fletemeyer, giuseppe chirico, alisa elezovic, winfried neuhaus lab animal department of information engineering, university of pisa, pisa, italy. arti.ahluwalia@unipi.it.; centro 3r, pisa, italy. arti.ahluwalia@unipi.it.

title: A Mutual Information Lower Bound for Multimodal Regression Active Learning
authors: Leonardo Ferreira Guilhoto, Akshat Kaushal, Paris Perdikaris
blob: a mutual information lower bound for multimodal regression active learning active learning for continuous regression has lacked an acquisition function that targets epistemic uncertainty when the predictive distribution is multimodal: variance misses modal disagreement, and information-theoretic targets like bald are designed for discrete outputs. we introduce a two-index framework that makes this separation explicit: one stochastic index selects among competing model hypotheses (epistemic source), while a second governs within-hypothesis randomness (aleatoric source). 该论文提出了一种针对多模态回归的主动学习方法，其不确定性量化思想可迁移至代理模型中的主动采样，但未涉及有限元或生物力学设计。 no fea validation, no biomedical context, no implant mechanics, and no constraint handling. 现有主动学习方法无法处理多模态回归中的认知不确定性。 提出双索引框架和互信息下界采集函数，用于混合密度网络集成。 在多模态基准上一致优于基线方法。 在多个多模态回归基准数据集上测试。 existing active learning acquisition functions fail to target epistemic uncertainty when the predictive distribution is multimodal. a two-index framework is introduced to separate epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty, and a closed-form mutual information lower bound (mi-lb) acquisition function is derived for mixture density network ensembles. mi-lb consistently matches or outperforms all baselines on multimodal regression benchmarks. evaluated on several synthetic and real-world multimodal regression benchmarks. active learning uncertainty quantification mixture density network mutual information regression active learning 主动学习 epistemic uncertainty 认知不确定性 aleatoric uncertainty 偶然不确定性 mixture density network 混合密度网络 mutual information 互信息 acquisition function 采集函数 multimodal regression 多模态回归 leonardo ferreira guilhoto, akshat kaushal, paris perdikaris arxiv preprint
